crImport.review.merged_other: Plural form of crImport.review.merged_one: {count} (≥ 2) platform seasons merged into one check because they lead to the same AniList entry.
crImport.review.series: Where: history import preview (full tab), start of a 'To check' row instead of a season label: 'Series · episode 12'. Meaning: the history gives no season for this item, so it refers to the whole series. Length: short (≤ 15 chars). Notes: capitalized noun.
crImport.review.create_one: Where: history import preview (full tab), button at the bottom of the 'To check' block (one line). Meaning: create 'To check' cards for the ticked seasons, to resolve in the popup's Activity tab. Placeholders: {count} = ticked seasons. Length: short (≤ 28 chars). Notes: imperative; review = check card (FR vérification).
crImport.review.create_other: Plural form of crImport.review.create_one (button creating {count} 'To check' cards).
crImport.review.created_one: Where: history import page (full tab), green notice at the top. Meaning: 'To check' cards were created; the user now picks the right entry for each in the popup's Activity tab. Placeholders: {count} = cards created. Length: medium-long. Notes: 'Activity' = nav.activity; imperative.
crImport.review.created_other: Plural form of crImport.review.created_one ({count} 'To check' cards created, to resolve in the popup's Activity tab).
crImport.review.createdLimited_one: Where: history import page (full tab), green notice at the top. Meaning: only some cards were created because at most 20 'To check' cards can be pending: resolve them, then come back and create the next ones. Placeholders: {count} = cards created. Length: long. Notes: keep the number 20.
crImport.review.createdLimited_other: Plural form of crImport.review.createdLimited_one ({count} cards created, limit of 20 pending cards reached).
crImport.reason.numbering: Where: history import preview (full tab), reason line under a 'To check' row; also saved as the reason on the resulting 'To check' card (popup › Activity). Meaning: the episode's position within its season is unknown (the season was probably removed from the platform's catalog). Length: medium-long.
crImport.skipReason.up-to-date: Where: history import preview (full tab), service chip 'AL up to date' (also result text 'MyAnimeList: up to date'). Meaning: the list's progress is already equal or ahead, nothing to write. Length: very short (≤ 15 chars). Notes: lowercase label after a service name.
crImport.skipReason.completed: Where: history import preview (full tab), service chip 'AL completed' (also result text 'AniList: completed'). Meaning: the series is already marked Completed in the user's list (not 'finished airing'), so it is left alone. Length: very short (≤ 15 chars). Notes: lowercase; FR terminée agrees with série.
crImport.skipReason.repeating: Where: history import preview (full tab), service chip 'AL rewatching' (also in result text). Meaning: the series has the Rewatching status in the user's list, so the import leaves it alone. Length: very short (≤ 18 chars). Notes: lowercase; reuse your term for the list status Rewatching.
crImport.skipReason.beyond: Where: history import preview (full tab), service chip 'AL beyond the entry'. Meaning: the history's episode number exceeds the episode count of that AniList/MAL entry (seasons split differently), so nothing is written. Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: lowercase; entry = AniList/MAL page of the anime (FR fiche).
crImport.skipReason.no-equivalent: Where: history import preview (full tab), MyAnimeList chip 'MAL no equivalent'. Meaning: the AniList entry has no linked MyAnimeList entry, so MyAnimeList can't be updated. Length: short (≤ 18 chars). Notes: lowercase.
crImport.skip.notConnected: Where: history import preview (full tab), result line under a series after the import (also in the result banner tooltip). Meaning: that service was disconnected meanwhile, so it was skipped. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: short.
crImport.skip.sessionClosed: Where: history import preview (full tab), result line under a series, and inside 'Import interrupted: {message}'. Meaning: the user signed out or switched account on that service during the import; nothing was written and the import stops. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: medium. Notes: lowercase after the colon.
crImport.result.updated: Where: history import preview (full tab), green result line under a series after the import. Meaning: the series was written to the list(s). Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: past participle, capitalized.
crImport.result.skipped: Where: history import preview (full tab), muted result line under a series after the import (when no more specific reason is given). Meaning: nothing needed to be written for this series. Length: short (≤ 25 chars).
crImport.result.failed: Where: history import preview (full tab), red result line under a series after the import (when no error text is available). Meaning: writing this series failed. Length: short (≤ 20 chars).
crImport.restart: Where: history import page (full tab), outlined button at the bottom of the preview and after an ended analysis. Meaning: discard the current preview/analysis and begin a new import from the start. Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: imperative.
crImport.error.notConnected: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box (also inside 'Analysis interrupted: {message}'). Meaning: no AniList or MyAnimeList account is connected; connect one in the extension's Settings. Length: medium. Notes: 'Settings' = nav.settings screen name; imperative.
crImport.error.busy: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box. Meaning: another history analysis or import is still running; only one can run at a time. Length: medium.
crImport.error.empty: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box after reading. Meaning: the history contains no episode watched to the end (per the completion threshold in Settings). Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll or ADN. Length: medium.
crImport.error.noHistory: Where: history import page (full tab), inside 'Analysis interrupted: {message}'. Meaning: the history data read earlier is no longer stored; the user must read it again ('Read my history'). Length: medium.
crImport.error.noPlan: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box or inside 'Import interrupted: {message}'. Meaning: the preview (import plan shown before writing) no longer exists; the analysis must be run again. Length: medium.
crImport.error.sessionClosed: Where: history import page (full tab), inside 'Analysis interrupted: {message}'. Meaning: the user signed out of, or switched, an AniList/MyAnimeList account while the analysis ran, so it must be run again. Length: medium-long.
crImport.error.nothingSelected: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box. Meaning: no series checkbox is ticked in the preview, so nothing can be imported. Length: short.
crImport.error.noJob: Where: history import page (full tab), error returned when Stop is clicked but no analysis/import is running (currently not displayed). Meaning: nothing to stop. Length: short.
crImport.error.unexpected: Where: history import page (full tab), red error box. Meaning: generic unexpected error during the watch history import. Length: medium.
engagement.declineFailed: Where: error text returned when answering 'No' to the in-page rewatch question; currently only written to the browser console. Meaning: the 'no rewatch' choice (don't ask again for 30 days) could not be saved. Length: short. Notes: informal 'your' (FR ton, DE deine).
engagement.deferFailed: Where: error text returned when postponing a rating ('Later'); currently only written to the browser console. Meaning: the 'rate later' card (popup Activity › To rate) could not be saved. Length: short.
engagement.lastEpisode: Where: in-page toast line after 'Yes, rewatching' ('AniList · …'). Meaning: rewatch not started on that service because episode {progress} is the series' last episode. Placeholders: {progress} = episode number, e.g. 12. Length: medium. Notes: reason fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no final period.
engagement.notCompleted: Where: in-page toast line after 'Yes, rewatching' ('AniList · …'). Meaning: rewatch not started on that service because the user's list entry is not marked Completed. Length: short. Notes: reason fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no final period.
engagement.notInList: Where: popup/side panel result text, in-page toast lines, '{service}: …' details. Meaning: the series is not in the user's list on that service (AniList/MyAnimeList), so nothing was written. Length: short. Notes: also standalone; after '{service}: ' code lowercases the first letter (not German); FR agrees with 'série' (fem.).
list.remove: Where: '⋯' menu item (red, trash icon) of a popup Watching row and of the side panel card; also screen-reader label of the confirmation box. Meaning: action: delete this anime from the user's AniList/MyAnimeList list. Length: short (menu ≈ 200 px).
list.remove.confirm: Where: inline confirmation inside the '⋯' menu (popup, side panel), bold line above the Remove / Cancel buttons. Meaning: asks to confirm deleting the series from the user's list. Length: short (≈ 25 chars, truncated). Notes: informal 'your' (FR ta, DE deine).
list.remove.detail: Where: tooltip (title attribute) of the remove confirmation box (popup, side panel). Meaning: the series will be deleted from the list of every connected account. Length: medium. Notes: AniList and MyAnimeList are product names; FR participle agrees with 'série' (feminine).
list.remove.noAria: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the 'Cancel' button in the remove confirmation. Meaning: cancel deleting this series from the list. Placeholders: {title} = anime title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: medium (not visible).
list.remove.yes: Where: small red confirmation button next to 'Cancel' in the remove confirmation (popup/side panel menu). Meaning: verb: confirm deleting the series from the list. Length: short (≈ 12 chars).
list.remove.yesAria: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the red 'Remove' confirmation button. Meaning: delete this series from the user's list. Placeholders: {title} = anime title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: medium (not visible). Notes: informal 'your' (FR ta, DE deine).
notes.add: Where: collapsed comment row (button) of the popup 'On this page' card and side panel 'Your progress', after the 'Comment' label, when no comment exists. Meaning: invites the user to write a personal comment on their list entry. Length: short (one line, truncated). Notes: comment = private note (AniList Notes / MAL Comments).
notes.counterAria: Where: screen-reader label of the character counter under the comment box (visible text '123 / 6000'). Placeholders: {count} = characters typed (0–6000); {max} = 6000. Length: short (not visible). Notes: not pluralized; prefer a form where the noun agrees with {max} or fits any count.
notes.editAria: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the comment text box, of the collapsed comment button and of the popup's comment panel. Meaning: the personal comment for this anime. Placeholders: {title} = anime title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: short (not visible). Notes: 'Comment' is a noun here.
notes.loading: Where: placeholder inside the comment text box (popup) while the saved comment is being read from AniList/MyAnimeList. Meaning: loading the existing comment. Length: short. Notes: keep the ellipsis.
notes.menu: Where: popup Watching tab, item of a series row's '⋯' menu (pencil icon). Meaning: opens the editor of the personal comment on the list entry. Length: short (menu ≈ 200 px). Notes: 'Comment' is a NOUN, not the verb; the ellipsis means it opens an editor.
notes.notInList: Where: note under the comment editor (popup, side panel) and result text after saving. Meaning: the series is not in the user's AniList/MyAnimeList list, so no comment can be written; add it first. Length: medium. Notes: informal you (FR tu, DE du).
notes.placeholder: Where: placeholder of the empty comment text box (popup, side panel). Meaning: invites typing the personal comment for this list entry. Length: short. Notes: informal 'your' (FR ton, DE dein); keep the ellipsis.
notes.save: Where: small button under the comment text box, next to 'Cancel'. Meaning: verb: save the comment. Length: short (≈ 12 chars).
notes.title: Where: label above the comment text box and in the collapsed comment row (popup, side panel). Meaning: noun: the user's personal comment/note on their list entry (AniList 'Notes', MyAnimeList 'Comments'), not a public review. Length: short.
entry.openAria: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of clickable anime titles (popup, side panel); also after '{label}: ' for related series. Meaning: opens the anime's page on AniList/MyAnimeList in a new tab ('entry' = that page, FR « fiche »). Placeholders: {title} = anime title; {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: medium.
error.unexpected: Where: generic error message from the service worker, shown in popup/side panel alerts and toasts. Meaning: an unexpected internal error occurred (no specific cause known). Length: short.
error.unexpectedAdd: Where: error in the 'On this page' card (popup) / side panel. Meaning: unexpected internal error while adding the series to the user's AniList/MyAnimeList list (Plan to watch or Watching). Length: medium.
error.unexpectedAdjust: Where: error shown in the popup/side panel after the +1/−1 buttons. Meaning: unexpected internal error while changing the number of watched episodes (progress). Length: medium.
error.unexpectedNotes: Where: error shown in the popup/side panel after saving a comment. Meaning: unexpected internal error while saving the personal comment on the list entry. Length: medium.
error.unexpectedRating: Where: error in the in-page rating bubble, popup Activity › To rate cards, 'On this page' card, side panel. Meaning: unexpected internal error while saving the user's score (rating out of 10). Length: medium.
error.unexpectedRemove: Where: error shown in the popup/side panel after 'Remove from list'. Meaning: unexpected internal error while deleting the series from the user's list. Length: medium.
error.unexpectedRewatch: Where: error in the in-page toast after answering 'Yes, rewatching'. Meaning: unexpected internal error while starting a rewatch (setting the completed series to 'Rewatching'). Length: medium.
error.unexpectedStatus: Where: error shown in the popup/side panel after changing a series' list status (On hold, Dropped, Completed). Meaning: unexpected internal error while changing that status. Length: medium.
error.unexpectedSync: Where: error message of a sync (in-page toast 'Sync failed', popup Activity › To check, side panel). Meaning: unexpected internal error while sending the watched episode to AniList/MyAnimeList. Length: medium. Notes: 'sync' = synchronization (noun).
feedback.completedTitle: Where: in-page toast bubble title on the streaming site (also popup results). Meaning: the synced episode was the last one: the anime is now marked Completed in the user's list. Placeholders: {title} = anime title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: short (bold title, 280 px bubble, wraps).
feedback.error.queued: Where: in-page error toast message (under 'Sync failed'); side panel live status. Meaning: the sync failed temporarily; SyncKai will retry automatically soon. Placeholders: {message} = error sentence ending with a period, e.g. 'AniList is unreachable. Check your connection.' Length: medium. Notes: keep {message} first.
feedback.error.title: Where: in-page error toast title on the streaming site; also popup notices. Meaning: sending the watched episode to AniList/MyAnimeList failed. Length: short (bold title). Notes: 'Sync' = synchronization (noun), not a verb.
feedback.excluded: Where: in-page toast bubble message (Detailed notification level only) under the series title; also popup details. Meaning: the user excluded this series from sync ('Stop syncing this series'), so nothing was sent. Length: short. Notes: full sentence, final period.
feedback.ignored.message: Where: popup result text (e.g. after 'Retry' in Activity), as '{title}: {message}'; never in in-page toasts. Meaning: on Netflix/Disney+, no AniList entry links to this title, so it is probably not an anime and was not synced. Length: medium. Notes: AniList is a product name; 'entry' = AniList page (FR « fiche »).
feedback.ignored.title: Where: popup/side panel result text (short status), and title paired with feedback.ignored.message. Meaning: SyncKai skipped this series (Netflix/Disney+ title not recognized as an anime). Length: short.
feedback.notConnected.message: Where: in-page warning toast message on the streaming site; side panel live status detail. Meaning: an episode was watched but no account is signed in; click the SyncKai toolbar icon (extension button) to connect one. Length: medium. Notes: informal you (FR tu, DE du); product names untranslated.
feedback.notConnected.title: Where: in-page warning toast title, popup footer status bar, side panel live status, popup result texts. Meaning: no AniList or MyAnimeList account is signed in, so nothing can be synced. Length: short (footer is one truncated line).
feedback.queuedSuffix: Where: side panel live status and popup details/notices, glued after the per-service results, e.g. 'AniList: episode 5 saved · MyAnimeList: failed: …' + this. Meaning: the failed services will be retried automatically soon. Length: short. Notes: starts with '. ' (period + space) and is appended directly; keep the leading period (or '。'): it is dropped automatically when the text before already ends a sentence (. ! ? 。 …), so '..' and '。。' never appear.
feedback.review.message: Where: in-page warning toast message; side panel live status detail. Meaning: unsure which AniList entry matches, nothing written; open SyncKai (toolbar icon) to pick it. Placeholders: {reason} = translated reason without final period, e.g. 'Found by title only (…)'. Length: long. Notes: informal you; product names untranslated.
feedback.review.title: Where: in-page warning toast title on the streaming site. Meaning: the match must be checked/confirmed by the user in SyncKai's popup (Activity › To check). 'Check' = verify, not a checkmark. Length: short. Notes: SyncKai is a product name.
feedback.service.completed: Where: per-service result in the in-page toast ('AniList · …') and popup/side panel details ('AniList: …'). Meaning: progress saved at episode {progress} and the anime is now Completed in the list. Placeholders: {progress} = episode number, e.g. 12. Length: short. Notes: fragment, lowercase start (German nouns capitalized), no period.
feedback.service.error: Where: per-service result in the in-page toast ('MyAnimeList · …') and popup/side panel details ('MyAnimeList: …'). Meaning: writing to that service failed. Placeholders: {message} = error sentence, e.g. 'MyAnimeList is unreachable. Check your connection.' Length: short prefix. Notes: fragment, lowercase start.
feedback.service.upToDate: Where: per-service result in the in-page toast ('AniList · …') and popup/side panel details. Meaning: nothing written: the list already had this episode (or a later one). Placeholders: {progress} = progress already in the list, e.g. 5. Length: short. Notes: fragment, lowercase start (German nouns capitalized), no period.
feedback.service.updated: Where: per-service result in the in-page toast ('AniList · …') and popup/side panel details ('AniList: …'). Meaning: the list progress was set to episode {progress}. Placeholders: {progress} = episode number, e.g. 5. Length: short. Notes: fragment, lowercase start (German nouns capitalized), no final period.
footer.allSynced: Where: popup footer status bar (one truncated line, beside account avatars and version). Meaning: nothing pending: every watched episode has been synced. Often followed by ' · ' + relative time of the last sync, e.g. '5 min ago'. Length: short (≈ 22 chars).
footer.chip.expired: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of a round account avatar in the popup footer; clicking opens Settings. Meaning: the sign-in to this service has expired (reconnection needed). Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: medium (not visible).
footer.chip.ok: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of a round account avatar in the popup footer; clicking opens Settings. Meaning: this account is signed in. Placeholders: {service} = AniList or MyAnimeList. Length: medium (not visible).
footer.queueFailed_one: Where: popup footer status button (red, opens Activity). Meaning: pending syncs that SyncKai stopped retrying automatically and that need the user's action. Placeholders: {count} = number, e.g. 1. Length: short (≈ 22 chars, one line). Notes: 'sync' = noun (a synchronization).
footer.queueFailed_other: Plural form of footer.queueFailed_one (e.g. '3 syncs failed'). Where: popup footer status button (red, opens Activity). Placeholders: {count} = number of failed syncs. Length: short (≈ 22 chars, one line).
footer.queuePending_one: Where: popup footer status button (opens Activity). Meaning: syncs that failed temporarily and are waiting for an automatic retry. Placeholders: {count} = number, e.g. 1. Length: short (≈ 22 chars, one line). Notes: 'sync' = noun.
footer.queuePending_other: Plural form of footer.queuePending_one (e.g. '2 syncs pending'). Where: popup footer status button (opens Activity). Placeholders: {count} = number of syncs waiting for a retry. Length: short (≈ 22 chars, one line).
footer.seeActivity: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the popup footer status button. Meaning: the button text + 'open the Activity tab'. Placeholders: {label} = translated footer text, e.g. '2 syncs pending' or '1 series to rate'. Length: medium (not visible). Notes: 'activity' = the Activity tab (nav.activity).
footer.toRate_one: Where: popup footer status button (star icon, opens Activity). Meaning: completed series whose rating was postponed ('Later'), waiting in Activity › To rate. Placeholders: {count} = number, e.g. 1. Length: short (≈ 22 chars, one line). Notes: 'rate' = give a score.
footer.toRate_other: Plural form of footer.toRate_one (e.g. '3 series to rate'). Where: popup footer status button (opens Activity › To rate). Placeholders: {count} = number of series to rate. Length: short (≈ 22 chars, one line).
footer.toReview_one: Where: popup footer status button (warning icon, opens Activity). Meaning: matches waiting for the user to confirm the right AniList entry (Activity › To check cards). Placeholders: {count} = number, e.g. 1. Length: short (≈ 22 chars, one line). Notes: 'check' = verify.
footer.toReview_other: Plural form of footer.toReview_one (e.g. '2 items to check'). Where: popup footer status button (opens Activity › To check). Placeholders: {count} = number of matches to verify. Length: short (≈ 22 chars, one line).
help.issue.body: Where: not in the UI; Markdown body of the GitHub issue opened by 'Report a problem'. Placeholders: {version} = '2.3.1'; {browser} = e.g. 'Chrome 141 · Windows'; {language} = UI language code ('fr'). Notes: keep Markdown (**, ###, 1., _…_), line breaks, '›'; last-line path = your labels (Settings › Help › Copy diagnostic report). Keep short (URL).
import.choose: Where: Backup page (full tab), outlined file-picker button that opens the system file dialog. Meaning: pick a SyncKai backup file (.json) to import. Length: short (≤ 25 chars). Notes: keep the ellipsis (a dialog opens).
import.chooseOther: Where: Backup page (full tab), outlined file-picker button below a loaded file. Meaning: pick a different backup file instead. Length: short (≤ 30 chars). Notes: keep the ellipsis.
import.closeTab: Where: Backup page (full tab), outlined button after a successful import. Meaning: closes this browser tab. Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: imperative.
import.done: Where: Backup page (full tab), large success message with check icon. Meaning: the backup file was imported successfully. Length: short.
import.doneHint: Where: Backup page (full tab), small text under 'Import complete'. Meaning: nothing else to do, the tab can be closed. Length: short. Notes: informal you (FR tu, DE du).
import.eraseAndImport: Where: Backup page (full tab), red confirm button in the Replace warning box (next to Cancel). Meaning: erase the current data, then import the file. Length: short (≤ 25 chars). Notes: imperative.
import.exportedOn: Where: Backup page (full tab), right after the bold file name: 'backup.json · exported on October 13, 2026 at 9:09 PM (v2.3.1)'. Meaning: when and with which SyncKai version the backup was made. Placeholders: {date} = localized long date and time; {version} = app version, e.g. 2.3.1. Notes: keep the leading space and ' · '.
import.failed: Where: Backup page (full tab), red error box. Meaning: the import failed and the user's data was left unchanged; retry. Length: medium.
import.import: Where: Backup page (full tab), main button (pink; red in Replace mode, which asks for confirmation). Meaning: import the chosen backup file (verb). Length: short (≤ 15 chars).
import.importing: Where: Backup page (full tab), busy label with spinner on the Import / 'Erase and import' button. Meaning: the import is in progress. Length: short (≤ 15 chars). Notes: keep the ellipsis.
import.includeSettings: Where: Backup page (full tab), checkbox label (ticked by default in Replace mode). Meaning: also import the settings stored in the backup file. Length: short-medium.
import.includeSettingsMissing: Where: Backup page (full tab), disabled checkbox label. Meaning: same as import.includeSettings, but the file contains no settings. Length: medium.
import.intro: Where: Backup page (full tab), intro of the Import section. Meaning: what a backup contains. matches = remembered season → AniList entry links (FR correspondances); history = SyncKai's sync history and pending cards, not a streaming history; sign-ins (account tokens) are never included. Length: medium-long.
import.invalid_one: Where: Backup page (full tab), amber warning under the file summary. Meaning: items in the file that failed validation and will be ignored. Placeholders: {count} = items. Length: short-medium.
import.invalid_other: Plural form of import.invalid_one (amber warning on the Backup page). Placeholders: {count} = invalid items in the backup file, ignored, e.g. 3.
import.merge.detail: Where: Backup page (full tab), small text under the 'Merge (recommended)' radio option. Meaning: this mode adds the file's data to the current data without overwriting what exists. Length: short-medium. Notes: 3rd-person verb, implied subject = the mode.
import.merge.title: Where: Backup page (full tab), bold label of an import-mode radio option. Meaning: combine the file's data with the current data; the recommended mode. Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
import.mode: Where: Backup page (full tab), legend of the radio group (small, uppercase via CSS). Meaning: how to import: Merge or Replace. Length: short.
import.pageTitle: Where: browser tab title (document.title) of the Backup page. Meaning: 'Backup' (noun: export/import of SyncKai data) + app name. Length: short. Notes: same word as import.title and settings.section.backup; keep ' · SyncKai'.
import.readFailed: Where: Backup page (full tab), red error box. Meaning: the selected file could not be read; retry. Length: medium.
import.reading: Where: Backup page (full tab), status line with spinner. Meaning: the chosen backup file is being read and checked. Length: short. Notes: keep the ellipsis.
import.replace.detail: Where: Backup page (full tab), small text under the 'Replace' radio option. Meaning: this mode erases the current data of these kinds (matches, excluded series, history) and replaces it with the file's content. Length: short-medium. Notes: 3rd-person verb, implied subject = the mode.
import.replace.title: Where: Backup page (full tab), bold label of an import-mode radio option. Meaning: replace the current data with the file's data. Length: short (≤ 20 chars).
import.replaceWarning: Where: Backup page (full tab), red confirmation box (Replace mode) with Cancel and 'Erase and import' buttons. Meaning: the current data will be erased; history = SyncKai's sync history, not a streaming history. Length: medium-long. Notes: ends with a yes/no question.
import.subtitle: Where: Backup page (full tab), subtitle under the 'Backup' heading. Meaning: what the page does; matches = remembered season → AniList entry links; history = SyncKai's sync history, not a streaming history. Length: medium. Notes: imperative verbs, informal you.
import.section.export: Where: Backup page (full tab), section heading (small, uppercase via CSS) above the Export button. Meaning: export = download a backup file. Length: short (≤ 15 chars). Notes: FR/DE use the infinitive verb.
import.section.import: Where: Backup page (full tab), section heading (small, uppercase via CSS). Meaning: import = load a backup file. Length: short (≤ 15 chars). Notes: FR/DE use the infinitive verb.
import.export.help: Where: Backup page (full tab), help text left of the Export button. Meaning: the export is a .json file that never contains the AniList/MyAnimeList sign-ins (account tokens). Length: short-medium. Notes: keep '.json' and 'AniList/MAL'.
import.export.started: Where: Backup page (full tab), green status with check icon in the Export section. Meaning: the backup file download has begun. Length: short.
import.summary.excludedSeries_one: Where: Backup page (full tab), file summary table: row label; the number is in a separate right column. Meaning: series the user excluded from sync. Placeholders: none shown ({count} only picks the form). Length: short. Notes: lowercase in EN/FR.
import.summary.excludedSeries_other: Plural form of import.summary.excludedSeries_one (row label, number shown separately).
import.summary.included: Where: Backup page (full tab), file summary table, bold value of the 'settings' row. Meaning: the file contains the settings. Length: very short (≤ 12 chars). Notes: agrees with 'settings' (plural noun in FR).
import.summary.mediaMappings_one: Where: Backup page (full tab), file summary row label (number in a separate right column). Meaning: a remembered link between a platform season and an AniList entry (FR correspondance), as in Settings › Matches. Length: short. Notes: no {count} shown; lowercase in EN/FR.
import.summary.mediaMappings_other: Plural form of import.summary.mediaMappings_one (matches: remembered season → AniList entry links).
import.summary.missing: Where: Backup page (full tab), file summary table, bold value of the 'settings' row. Meaning: the file contains no settings. Length: very short (≤ 12 chars). Notes: agrees with 'settings' (FR absents; DE uses a verb, fehlen).
import.summary.pendingRatings_one: Where: Backup page (full tab), file summary row label (number in a separate right column). Meaning: pending 'To rate' cards: finished series waiting for the user's score. Length: short. Notes: no {count} shown; lowercase in EN/FR.
import.summary.pendingRatings_other: Plural form of import.summary.pendingRatings_one (series waiting to be rated).
import.summary.pendingReviews_one: Where: Backup page (full tab), file summary row label (number in a separate right column). Meaning: pending 'To check' cards: episodes with an uncertain match awaiting the user's decision. Length: short. Notes: no {count} shown; lowercase in EN/FR.
import.summary.pendingReviews_other: Plural form of import.summary.pendingReviews_one (episodes to check).
import.summary.recentSyncs_one: Where: Backup page (full tab), file summary row label (number in a separate right column). Meaning: an entry of SyncKai's recent sync log (sync = noun, synchronization). Length: short. Notes: no {count} shown; lowercase in EN/FR.
import.summary.recentSyncs_other: Plural form of import.summary.recentSyncs_one (recent sync log entries).
import.summary.rewatchDeclined_one: Where: Backup page (full tab), file summary row label (number in a separate right column). Meaning: a series for which the user declined SyncKai's offer to start a rewatch (not asked again for 30 days). Length: short. Notes: no {count} shown; lowercase in EN/FR.
import.summary.rewatchDeclined_other: Plural form of import.summary.rewatchDeclined_one (declined rewatch offers).
import.summary.settings: Where: Backup page (full tab), first row label of the file summary table; its value is 'included' or 'missing'. Meaning: SyncKai's settings (preferences). Length: short. Notes: lowercase in EN/FR.
import.title: Where: Backup page (full tab), main h1 heading. Meaning: Backup as a noun (export/import of SyncKai data). Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: same word as settings.section.backup.
import.tooLarge: Where: Backup page (full tab), red error box. Meaning: the chosen file is over 5 MB, so it cannot be a SyncKai backup. Length: medium. Notes: keep 5 MB (use your unit abbreviation, e.g. FR Mo).
inline.backTo: Where: popup › Watching, short feedback chip on the series row after '−1' (also the feedback line of the 'On this page' card and side panel › Now playing). Meaning: progress moved back to this episode. Placeholders: {progress} = new last-watched episode number, e.g. 4. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: 'ep.' abbreviation expected.
inline.excluded: Where: feedback chip/line after an action (popup › Watching, 'On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: nothing was written because the series is excluded from syncing. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: no final period.
inline.notInListOn: Where: feedback after +1/−1 (row chip in popup › Watching, feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel). Meaning: progress saved, but the series is not in the named service's list, so nothing was written there. Placeholders: {text} = feedback text, e.g. 'Ep. 5 watched'; {services} = service name(s), e.g. 'MyAnimeList' or 'AniList and MyAnimeList' (list in the UI language). Length: medium.
inline.nothingChanged: Where: warning feedback after +1/−1 or a status change (row chip or top banner in popup › Watching, feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel). Meaning: the action changed nothing in any list. Length: short. Notes: no final period.
inline.nothingSaved: Where: warning under a 'To rate' card (popup › Activity) or feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel after rating. Meaning: the rating was not written anywhere. Length: short. Notes: no final period.
inline.notesCleared: Where: success feedback (row chip in popup › Watching, feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel). Meaning: the comment of the list entry (AniList 'notes' / MAL 'comments' field) was emptied. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: past participle, no final period.
inline.notesSaved: Where: same places as inline.notesCleared. Meaning: the comment of the list entry (AniList 'notes' / MAL 'comments' field) was saved. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: past participle, no final period.
inline.partial: Where: warning feedback (row chip or top banner in popup › Watching, feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel), with Retry after +1/−1. Meaning: action done except on the named service(s). Placeholders: {text} = success text, e.g. 'Ep. 5 watched' or 'Frieren: completed'; {services} = 'MyAnimeList' or 'AniList and MyAnimeList' (list in the UI language). Length: medium.
inline.rateInActivity: Where: appended to the banner after marking a series completed: '{title}: completed · Rate it in Activity.' Meaning: a 'To rate' card was created in the Activity tab, where the user can rate the series. Length: short. Notes: 'Activity' = popup tab name (nav.activity); full sentence with final period.
inline.ratingFailedOn: Where: error under a 'To rate' card (popup › Activity) or feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel after rating. Meaning: the score couldn't be saved on these services. Placeholders: {services} = 'AniList', 'MyAnimeList' or both as a list in the UI language ('AniList and MyAnimeList'). Length: short-medium. Notes: informal imperative 'try again'.
inline.ratingSaved: Where: success notice in popup › Activity › To rate, and feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel. Meaning: the user's score was saved. Placeholders: {stars} = score in locale format, e.g. '8.5' (FR '8,5'); {title} = series title. Length: medium. Notes: '/10' = out of 10; 'Rating' = the user's score.
inline.removed: Where: top banner of popup › Watching and feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel after 'Remove from list'. Meaning: the series was deleted from the user's AniList/MAL list. Placeholders: {title} = series title, e.g. 'Solo Leveling'. Length: medium. Notes: participle agrees with 'series' (FR 'retirée'), not with the title.
inline.retryOn: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the 'Retry' button after a partial failure (top banner of popup › Watching, 'On this page', side panel). Meaning: write the same progress again, only on the failed service(s). Placeholders: {services} = 'MyAnimeList' or 'AniList and MyAnimeList' (list in the UI language). Length: medium.
inline.saving: Where: popup › Watching, small pill with a spinner on a series row while a status change or a removal is being sent. Meaning: update in progress. Length: short (pill, ~15 chars). Notes: ends with '…'.
inline.status.COMPLETED: Where: top banner of popup › Watching and feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel after 'Mark as completed'. Meaning: the list status is now Completed (the user finished the series). Placeholders: {title} = series title. Length: medium. Notes: may be followed by ' · Rate it in Activity.'; participle agrees with 'series' (FR 'terminée').
inline.status.DROPPED: Where: same as inline.status.COMPLETED, after 'Drop'. Meaning: the list status is now Dropped (the user abandoned the series). Placeholders: {title} = series title. Length: medium. Notes: use the AniList/MAL community term for 'Dropped'; participle agrees with 'series'.
inline.status.PAUSED: Where: same as inline.status.COMPLETED, after 'Put on hold'. Meaning: the list status is now Paused (AniList) / On-Hold (MAL). Placeholders: {title} = series title. Length: medium. Notes: use the community term; agrees with 'series'.
inline.toCheck: Where: warning feedback after an action (row chip in popup › Watching, feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel). Meaning: SyncKai isn't sure which AniList entry matches; confirm it in Activity › 'To check' (FR 'À vérifier'). Length: short (chip). Notes: same wording as the 'To check' section (review.title).
inline.updateFailed: Where: error feedback (row chip or top banner in popup › Watching, feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel) after +1/−1, a status change or an add. Meaning: nothing could be written to the lists. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: noun phrase, no final period.
inline.watched: Where: popup › Watching, success chip on the series row after '+1' (also feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel). Meaning: this episode is now marked as watched. Placeholders: {progress} = episode number, e.g. 5. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: 'Ep.' abbreviation expected.
match.absoluteSplit: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: continuous platform numbering (One Piece E1180) spread over the series' AniList entries. Placeholders: {count} = number of entries, always ≥ 2. Length: medium. Notes: no final period.
match.titleOnlyAbsolute: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: no platform link on AniList, but exactly one AniList entry has this title and the absolute episode number fits in it. Length: medium. Notes: no final period; entry = AniList page of an anime (FR 'fiche').
match.titleOnlySeason: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: no platform link, but the entry titled '… Season N' (e.g. 'Kaiju No. 8 Season 2') fits the absolute numbering. Placeholders: {season} = season number, e.g. 2. Notes: translate 'Season'; no final period.
match.specialTitle: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: the platform season is a special (OVA, movie…) and exactly one special-format AniList entry has its title. Length: medium. Notes: OVA = Original Video Animation, use the usual local term; no final period.
match.specialSeason: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: the episode belongs to a special season (OVA, extras, movie) and no entry could be chosen: the user must pick it. Length: medium. Notes: no final period.
match.beyondSeason: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: the episode number exceeds AniList's episode count for that season. Placeholders: {episode} = e.g. 25; {total} = AniList count, e.g. 13; {season} = season, e.g. 2. Notes: no final period.
match.beyondAniList: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: the episode number exceeds the episode count of the series' only AniList entry. Placeholders: {episode} = e.g. 1180; {total} = entry's count, e.g. 24 ('?' if unknown). Notes: no final period.
match.dedicatedSeason: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: an AniList entry exists specifically for this platform season (special or arc filed as a season). Placeholders: {title} = platform season title, e.g. 'HEROINES'. Notes: locale quotes; no final period.
match.dedicatedSeries: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: no regular season entry; exactly one AniList entry carries the series title (e.g. a special published as its own series). Notes: no final period; entry = AniList page of an anime (FR 'fiche').
match.episodeLink: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: an AniList entry (special, movie) has an external link to this exact episode page. Length: medium. Notes: no final period; entry = AniList page of an anime (FR 'fiche').
match.linkedEntry: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: a movie/special AniList entry is linked to this platform title (e.g. a Netflix film). Length: medium. Notes: no final period; entry = AniList page of an anime (FR 'fiche').
match.platformSeasonsSingle: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: only one AniList entry links to this show and it doesn't cover all its platform seasons: the season must be checked. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Notes: no final period.
match.platformTitleOnly: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: entry found by title only; no AniList entry links to this platform series. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Notes: implied subject = the entry (FR 'Trouvée'); no final period.
match.otherSeriesExcluded: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: an AniList entry linked to a different series page of the same platform was ruled out, so the chosen season is uncertain and must be checked. Length: medium. Notes: no final period.
match.platformUnlinkedEntry: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: the chosen entry was found by title, while another AniList entry is the one linked to this platform title. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Notes: subject = the entry; no final period.
match.noEntry: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: AniList returned no entry for this series. Placeholders: {title} = series title from the streaming site, e.g. 'Frieren'. Notes: locale quotes; no final period (page.notFound is the sentence form).
match.noNumber: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: the episode number couldn't be read from the streaming page. Length: short. Notes: no final period.
match.seasonByTitle: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: the AniList season entry was identified from the platform's season title. Placeholders: {title} = platform season title, e.g. 'Entertainment District Arc'. Length: medium. Notes: no final period.
match.seasonExact: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: platform season N = the N-th AniList entry of the series. Placeholders: {season} = season number, e.g. 2; {index} = entry position, e.g. 2. Notes: keep '='; {index} as an ordinal or 'no.'; no final period.
match.seasonGroup: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: AniList splits this season into several entries ('Part 2', 'Cour 2'); the episode is in part X of Y. Placeholders: {season} = season; {part} = e.g. 1; {parts} = total parts, e.g. 2. Notes: no final period.
match.seasonSplit: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: the season's episodes span several AniList entries, so the exact entry is uncertain. Placeholders: {season} = season number, e.g. 3. Length: medium. Notes: no final period.
match.single: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: the series has only one AniList entry and the episode fits in it. Length: short. Notes: noun phrase; no final period; entry = AniList page of an anime (FR 'fiche').
match.singleAbsolute: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: only one AniList entry for the series, and the platform numbers episodes absolutely (One Piece E1180). Length: short. Notes: no final period.
match.singleLaterSeason: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: the platform says season N (> 1) but AniList has only one entry for the series (sequel maybe unlinked), so it must be checked. Placeholders: {season} = e.g. 2 ('?' if unknown). Notes: no final period.
match.special: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: the episode number is not a whole number (e.g. 12.5, a special), so it isn't synced automatically. Length: medium. Notes: no final period.
match.titleOnly: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: entry found by title only, as no AniList entry links to the series' Crunchyroll / ADN page. Notes: Crunchyroll, ADN, AniList are names; subject = the entry; no final period.
match.titleOnlyTrusted: Where: explanation of how the AniList entry was chosen (mostly only logged); shown in a 'To check' card only if the match is uncertain. Meaning: no platform link, but exactly one AniList entry has this title and the episode is from season 1, so it is trusted. Length: medium. Notes: no final period.
match.undetermined: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: SyncKai couldn't work out which AniList entry corresponds to this platform season. Length: medium. Notes: no final period.
match.signalsAgree: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import, logs and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: the AniList entry was confirmed by data read on the streaming platform (not only by its title). Placeholders: {signals} = list of 'match.signal.*' labels, e.g. 'release year and episode count'. Length: medium. Notes: no final period; the subject is the AniList entry; avoid agreement with {signals} (hence the colon).
match.signalsContradict: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import, logs and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: data read on the streaming platform contradicts the AniList entry SyncKai would pick, so the match must be checked by the user. Placeholders: {signals} = list of 'match.signal.*' labels, e.g. 'release year'. Length: medium. Notes: no final period; avoid agreement with {signals} (hence the colon).
match.savedContradicted: Where: reason shown in 'To check' cards (popup › Activity), the history import, logs and the on-site toast '{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…'. Meaning: a match saved earlier for this season (season → AniList entry, possibly chosen by the user before this version or restored from a backup) is contradicted by data read on the streaming platform (e.g. release year), so SyncKai does not sync automatically and asks the user to confirm or pick the entry. Placeholders: {signals} = list of 'match.signal.*' labels, e.g. 'release year'. Length: medium. Notes: no final period; avoid agreement with {signals} (hence the colon); 'match' = the remembered season → entry link of the term sheet.
match.yearRemake: Where: reason shown in logs and, if the match is uncertain, 'To check' cards. Meaning: two AniList entries share the same title (an anime and its remake, e.g. Berserk 1997 and 2016); the release year given by the platform picked the right one. Placeholders: {year} = a four-digit year, e.g. 2016 (never formatted with separators). Length: medium. Notes: no final period; remake = a new adaptation of the same work.
match.signal.year: Where: one item of the {signals} list of 'match.signalsAgree' / 'match.signalsContradict' (several are joined by the language's list format: 'release year and episode count'), inside a reason shown in 'To check' cards and logs. Meaning: the year the season or series started airing. Length: short. Notes: lowercase (mid-sentence) unless the language capitalizes nouns.
match.signal.episodes: Where: one item of the {signals} list of 'match.signalsAgree' / 'match.signalsContradict' (several are joined by the language's list format: 'release year and episode count'), inside a reason shown in 'To check' cards and logs. Meaning: number of episodes of the season. Length: short. Notes: lowercase (mid-sentence) unless the language capitalizes nouns.
match.signal.duration: Where: one item of the {signals} list of 'match.signalsAgree' / 'match.signalsContradict' (several are joined by the language's list format: 'release year and episode count'), inside a reason shown in 'To check' cards and logs. Meaning: length of one episode (minutes). Length: short. Notes: lowercase (mid-sentence) unless the language capitalizes nouns.
match.signal.format: Where: one item of the {signals} list of 'match.signalsAgree' / 'match.signalsContradict' (several are joined by the language's list format: 'release year and episode count'), inside a reason shown in 'To check' cards and logs. Meaning: whether the work is a movie or a series. Length: short. Notes: lowercase (mid-sentence) unless the language capitalizes nouns.
match.signal.country: Where: one item of the {signals} list of 'match.signalsAgree' / 'match.signalsContradict' (several are joined by the language's list format: 'release year and episode count'), inside a reason shown in 'To check' cards and logs. Meaning: country where the anime was produced (Japan, China, Korea…). Length: short. Notes: lowercase (mid-sentence) unless the language capitalizes nouns.
match.signal.originalTitle: Where: one item of the {signals} list of 'match.signalsAgree' / 'match.signalsContradict' (several are joined by the language's list format: 'release year and episode count'), inside a reason shown in 'To check' cards and logs. Meaning: the title in the original language (Japanese or its romanization). Length: short. Notes: lowercase (mid-sentence) unless the language capitalizes nouns.
nav.activity: Where: popup, top navigation, 2nd of two tab buttons (Watching | Activity) sharing ~370 px; a count badge may follow. Meaning: screen with items to handle (matches to check, failed syncs, series to rate) and recent syncs. Quoted as '(Activity)' in other strings. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
nav.activityPending_one: Where: popup, aria-label (screen reader only) of the Activity tab when items are waiting. Placeholders: {count} = items to handle (matches to check + failed syncs + series to rate). Notes: starts with the tab name (nav.activity) then a comma. Keep {count} as digits: in some languages the 'one' form also covers 0 or 21, 31…
nav.activityPending_other: Plural form of nav.activityPending_one (e.g. 'Activity, 3 items to handle'); screen-reader label of the popup's Activity tab.
nav.back: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), top-left button on the Settings home (arrow icon + text); leaves Settings and returns to the previous screen or panel tab. Meaning: navigation 'Back'. Length: short, ≤ 10 chars (button min 76 px next to the centered title).
nav.sections: Where: popup, aria-label (screen reader only) of the navigation landmark holding the Watching / Activity tabs. Meaning: the popup's main sections/screens. Length: short, one word.
nav.settings: Where: popup & side panel: gear button tooltip/aria-label, title of the Settings home, text of the back button on Settings sub-pages (truncated). Also built into paths like 'Settings › Playback & sync' inside other sentences. Meaning: the extension's settings/preferences. Length: short, ≤ 15 chars.
nav.watching: Where: popup, top navigation, 1st of two tab buttons (Watching | Activity). Meaning: the user's series in progress, i.e. the 'Watching' status of their AniList/MyAnimeList list: use the same term as that list status (page.status.CURRENT). Quoted in 'open the Watching tab'. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
onboarding.hint.anilist: Where: popup welcome screen, small grey subtitle under the 'Connect AniList' button. Meaning: an AniList account is recommended because SyncKai relies on AniList data to match what you watch to the right anime. Length: short (≈ 35 chars, one line). Notes: 'matching' = identifying the anime/season.
onboarding.hint.mal: Where: popup welcome screen, small grey subtitle under the 'Connect MyAnimeList' button. Meaning: a MyAnimeList account can be used on its own or together with AniList. Length: short (≈ 35 chars, one line). Notes: AniList is a product name.
onboarding.howItWorks: Where: popup welcome screen, screen-reader label (aria-label) of the 3-step list at the bottom. Meaning: heading for the steps explaining how SyncKai works. Length: short (not visible).
onboarding.intro: Where: popup welcome screen, paragraph under 'Welcome!' (no account connected). Meaning: watch on supported sites and SyncKai updates your anime list at the end of each episode; Netflix, Disney+ and Prime Video must be enabled by the user. Length: medium (max 320 px, wraps). Notes: product names untranslated; informal you (FR tu, DE du).
onboarding.step1: Where: popup welcome screen, step 1 of 3 (numbered columns of ≈ 110 px, small text). Meaning: start playing an episode on a streaming site. Length: short (≈ 25 chars, max 2 lines). Notes: informal imperative (FR tu, DE du).
onboarding.step2: Where: popup welcome screen, step 2 of 3 (columns of ≈ 110 px, small text). Meaning: SyncKai automatically identifies which series is playing. Length: short (≈ 30 chars, max 2 lines). Notes: SyncKai is a product name.
onboarding.step3: Where: popup welcome screen, step 3 of 3 (columns of ≈ 110 px, small text). Meaning: by the time the episode's end credits roll, your AniList/MyAnimeList list is already updated. 'Credits' = end credits of the episode. Length: short (≈ 35 chars, max 2 lines). Notes: informal 'your'.
onboarding.welcome: Where: popup welcome screen, main heading (large) shown when no account is connected. Meaning: greeting to a new user. Length: short.
page.action.COMPLETED: Where: 'On this page' card (popup) and side panel › Now playing, visible text of the 3rd of three equal status buttons (icon + text). Meaning: mark the series Completed (asks for confirmation). Length: very short, ≤ 10 chars. Notes: compact form of watching.status.COMPLETED ('Mark as completed'), which is its tooltip.
page.action.DROPPED: Where: same button row, 2nd of three status buttons. Meaning: set the series to Dropped, i.e. abandon it (asks for confirmation). Length: very short, ≤ 10 chars. Notes: compact form of watching.status.DROPPED (its tooltip); must not read as 'Cancel'.
page.action.PAUSED: Where: same button row, 1st of three status buttons. Meaning: set the series to Paused / On hold. Length: very short, ≤ 10 chars. Notes: compact form of watching.status.PAUSED ('Put on hold'), which is its tooltip.
page.addCurrent: Where: 'On this page' card (popup) and side panel › Now playing, filled button (right of two side-by-side buttons) shown when the series is missing from a connected list. Meaning: add the series to your list as Watching. Length: short (~20 chars, truncated). Notes: status name must match page.status.CURRENT.
page.addPlanning: Where: same place, outlined button (left of the pair). Meaning: add the series to your list as Plan to watch (AniList 'Planning'). Length: short (~20 chars, truncated). Notes: status name must match page.status.PLANNING.
page.added.CURRENT: Where: success feedback line in the 'On this page' card and side panel › Now playing after 'Add to Watching'. Meaning: the series was added to your list with status Watching. Length: short. Notes: implied subject = the series (FR 'Ajoutée'); status name as page.status.CURRENT.
page.added.PLANNING: Where: same feedback line, after 'Add to Plan to watch'. Meaning: the series was added to your list with status Plan to watch. Length: short. Notes: implied subject = the series; status name as page.status.PLANNING.
page.airing.CANCELLED: Where: info line under the title ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing), e.g. 'Season 2 · 2023 · 12 eps. · Cancelled'. Meaning: AniList airing status: the anime was cancelled. Length: short. Notes: describes the anime (FR feminine 'Annulée' for 'série').
page.airing.FINISHED: Where: same info line. Meaning: the anime has finished airing (all episodes released). NOT the user's 'Completed' list status. Length: short. Notes: describes the anime (FR 'Terminée').
page.airing.HIATUS: Where: same info line. Meaning: airing is paused by the producers (hiatus). NOT the user's 'On hold' list status. Length: short.
page.airing.NOT_YET_RELEASED: Where: same info line. Meaning: the anime is announced but hasn't started airing yet. Length: short.
page.airing.RELEASING: Where: same info line. Meaning: the anime is currently airing (new episodes being released). Length: short.
page.alreadyInList: Where: info feedback line in 'On this page'/side panel after an Add; also per-service detail in tooltips ('AniList: already in your list', first letter lowercased except in German). Meaning: the series was already in your list, nothing changed. Length: short. Notes: no final period.
page.episodes_one: Where: info line under the title ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing), e.g. '2023 · 1 ep. · Finished'. Meaning: total episode count of the anime. Placeholders: {count} = 1. Length: short. Notes: abbreviation expected.
page.episodes_other: Plural form of page.episodes_one, e.g. '12 eps.'. Placeholders: {count} = episode count. Notes: abbreviation expected; only _one/_other exist, so this form serves every count not in 'one'.
page.listsAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the list giving the series' status in each connected AniList/MyAnimeList list ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Length: medium.
page.loading: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the loading placeholder of the 'On this page' card (popup). Meaning: the AniList entry is loading. Placeholders: {title} = series title read from the streaming page, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: medium.
page.manualNotSaved: Where: amber warning above the season dropdown ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: the user picked a season that doesn't contain the current episode: it is shown but not saved as the match. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'sync' = SyncKai's automatic syncing (noun).
page.minusOneAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the '−1' button ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: lower watched progress by one episode. Placeholders: {title} = AniList entry title. Length: medium.
page.notFound: Where: error alert with Retry in the 'On this page' card (popup) and message in side panel › Now playing. Meaning: no AniList entry was found for the series open in the tab. Placeholders: {title} = series title from the streaming site. Length: medium. Notes: full sentence with final period.
page.notTracked: Where: neutral grey message in the 'On this page' card and side panel › Now playing on Netflix/Disney+. Meaning: this title isn't an anime known to AniList, so SyncKai ignores it. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'track' = follow viewing progress.
page.platformOff: Where: same places as page.notTracked. Meaning: the user turned this optional platform off, so nothing is tracked. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'Settings › Playback & sync' must match the translated nav.settings and settings.cat.sync; keep '›'.
page.notInList: Where: per-service status line (AniList/MAL icon + text) in the 'On this page' card and side panel › Now playing. Meaning: the series isn't in this service's list. Length: short (truncated). Notes: no final period.
page.openOn: Where: visible menu item in a series row's '…' menu (popup › Watching); aria-label of the AniList/MAL link chips in the 'On this page' card header. Meaning: open the anime's page on AniList/MyAnimeList (new tab). Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Length: medium (menu ≤ 240 px).
page.seasonOption: Where: option text of the season dropdown ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Placeholders: {season} = season number, e.g. 2; {title} = AniList entry title with year, e.g. 'Mushoku Tensei II (2023)'. Length: medium. Notes: '—' separates season and title.
page.seasonOptionPart: Where: same dropdown, for a season split into several AniList entries. Placeholders: {season} = season number, e.g. 2; {part} = part number, e.g. 1; {title} = entry title with year. Length: medium. Notes: 'part' lowercase in EN/FR (follows '·').
page.seasonPicker: Where: visible label just before the season dropdown ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: 'Season' (noun): which season of the series the card shows. Length: very short.
page.seasonPickerAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the season dropdown. Meaning: choose which season's AniList entry is shown. Length: medium.
page.seasonSlot: Where: start of the info line under the title ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing), e.g. 'Season 2 · 2023 · 12 eps.'. Placeholders: {season} = season number, e.g. 2. Length: short.
page.seasonSlotPart: Where: same info line, for a season split across AniList entries. Placeholders: {season} = season number; {part} = this part, e.g. 1; {parts} = number of parts, e.g. 2. Length: short. Notes: 'part' lowercase in EN/FR (follows '·').
page.status.COMPLETED: Where: list-status chip and per-service lines ('Completed · Ep. 12 / 12') in the 'On this page' card and side panel; AniList↔MAL differences chips (popup › Activity). Meaning: user list status Completed = the user finished the series (not 'finished airing'). Length: short (chip, ~14 chars). Notes: AniList/MAL community term.
page.status.CURRENT: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Watching (series in progress; AniList/MAL 'Watching'). Length: short (chip). Notes: community term; in EN/FR/DE it equals the popup tab name (nav.watching); reused in page.addCurrent / page.added.CURRENT.
page.status.DROPPED: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Dropped (the user abandoned the series). Length: short (chip). Notes: AniList/MAL community term.
page.status.PAUSED: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Paused (AniList) / On-Hold (MAL). Length: short (chip). Notes: community term; not the airing 'hiatus'.
page.status.PLANNING: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Planning (AniList) / Plan to Watch (MAL). Length: short (chip). Notes: community term; reused in page.addPlanning / page.added.PLANNING.
page.status.REPEATING: Where: same as page.status.COMPLETED. Meaning: user list status Rewatching (AniList 'Rewatching', API 'REPEATING'; MAL 're-watching'). Length: short (chip). Notes: community term.
page.title: Where: popup › Watching, small label at the top of the card showing the AniList entry of the series open in the current tab; also the card's aria-label. Meaning: 'On this page' = the page of the active browser tab. Length: short.
page.unavailable: Where: per-service status line in the 'On this page' card and side panel › Now playing. Meaning: the anime has no equivalent entry on that service (e.g. no MyAnimeList page for the AniList entry). Length: short-medium (truncated). Notes: no final period.
page.uncertain: Where: amber warning above the season dropdown ('On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: SyncKai guessed the season; check it (and change it if needed) in the dropdown below. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
panel.agenda.soon: Where: side panel, placeholder card for a tab that isn't built yet (currently never shown: the Schedule tab exists). Meaning: this week's new episodes will be listed here. Length: medium, wraps.
panel.checking: Where: side panel, centered status with spinner when the panel opens. Meaning: the panel checks what the active browser tab shows (supported streaming page or not). Length: medium.
panel.live.autoSyncOff: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: automatic sync is turned off in Settings, so this episode won't be sent automatically. Length: short (≤ 30 chars, truncated). Notes: not the video being paused (see panel.live.paused).
panel.live.countdown: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, main line, updated every second. Meaning: time left before SyncKai saves the episode to the user's lists. Placeholders: {time} = remaining time, e.g. '2 min 10', '2 min', '45 s' (panel.live.minutes*/seconds). Length: short (truncated). Notes: 'Sync' = noun.
panel.live.error: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, red status line; the error message is shown below. Meaning: saving the episode to AniList/MyAnimeList failed. Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.live.excluded: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the user excluded this series from sync (Settings › Excluded series), so nothing is sent. Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.live.minutes: Where: side panel › Now playing, value inserted into panel.live.countdown ('Sync in {time}'). Meaning: whole minutes left. Placeholders: {min} = integer, e.g. 2. Length: very short. Notes: unit abbreviation.
panel.live.minutesSeconds: Where: side panel › Now playing, value inserted into panel.live.countdown ('Sync in {time}'). Meaning: minutes and seconds left, e.g. '2 min 05'. Placeholders: {min} = minutes; {sec} = two-digit seconds ('05'). Length: very short. Notes: the seconds unit is omitted in EN/FR/DE.
panel.live.noVideo: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: no video player was found on this episode page, so playback can't be followed. Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.live.paused: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the video is paused on the streaming site. Length: short. Notes: video state, not sync (compare panel.live.autoSyncOff).
panel.live.playback: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of the playback progress bar (screen readers only). Meaning: current position in the episode. Length: short.
panel.live.pointCredits: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, detail line '{this} · 21:30' and bar-marker tooltip. Meaning: the episode will be synced when the end credits start (21:30 = position in the episode). Length: short (≤ 26 chars). Notes: 'credits' = end credits (FR « générique »).
panel.live.pointPassed: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the playback position is already past the sync point (end credits or % threshold). Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.live.pointRatio: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, detail line '{this} · 20:24' and bar-marker tooltip. Meaning: the episode is synced once this share of it has been played. Placeholders: {percent} = integer, e.g. 85. Length: short. Notes: use the locale's percent format (FR '85 %').
panel.live.position: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-valuetext of the playback progress bar (screen readers only). Placeholders: {position} = current position, e.g. '12:34'; {duration} = episode length, e.g. '23:40'. Length: short.
panel.live.review: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, warning status line. Meaning: SyncKai isn't sure which AniList entry this is; the user must pick it in the popup's 'To check' section. Length: short. Notes: use the same wording as review.title / inline.toCheck.
panel.live.reviewHint: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, detail line under 'To check'. Meaning: click SyncKai's toolbar icon (opens the popup) to choose the right anime entry. Length: medium, wraps. Notes: 'entry' = AniList/MyAnimeList page of an anime (FR « fiche »); FR « tu ».
panel.live.seconds: Where: side panel › Now playing, value inserted into panel.live.countdown ('Sync in {time}'). Meaning: seconds left (under a minute). Placeholders: {sec} = integer, e.g. 45. Length: very short. Notes: unit abbreviation.
panel.live.synced: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, green status line. Meaning: the episode has been saved to the user's lists. Length: short. Notes: keep ' ✓'.
panel.live.syncing: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the episode is being saved to the user's AniList/MyAnimeList lists right now. Length: short.
panel.live.unreachable: Where: side panel › Now playing, hint (in the live block, or under 'Open a series or an episode…'). Meaning: the panel can't talk to the streaming tab (e.g. after an extension update); reloading that browser tab fixes it. Length: medium, wraps. Notes: imperative; FR « tu ».
panel.live.waiting: Where: side panel › Now playing › live progress block, status line. Meaning: the streaming site's video player isn't ready yet (duration unknown). Length: short (≤ 30 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.aria: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of the whole anime card (screen readers only). Meaning: the AniList entry (page) of the series open in the tab. Length: short. Notes: 'entry' = FR « fiche ».
panel.nowPlaying.connectHint: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Your progress' section, small text. Meaning: no account is connected; accounts are connected in the extension popup. Length: medium, wraps. Notes: AniList, MyAnimeList untranslated; FR « tu ».
panel.nowPlaying.detailsError: Where: side panel › Now playing, error alert with a Retry button. Meaning: the extra AniList details (synopsis, relations, banner…) failed to load. Notes: followed by the error sentence (after a space; none in Japanese and Chinese), e.g. 'AniList is unreachable. Check your connection.'; keep the final period. Length: medium.
panel.nowPlaying.detecting: Where: side panel › Now playing, centered status with spinner. Meaning: the panel is reading the streaming page to identify the series or episode. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.discussion: Where: side panel › Now playing, section heading (shown UPPERCASE) above links to Reddit, the MAL forum and AniList. Meaning: discussion threads about the episode or series. Length: short (≤ 20 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.episode: Where: side panel › Now playing, right of the 'Your progress' heading (pink, bold). Meaning: the episode open in the tab (numbered as on the AniList entry) out of the entry's total episodes. Placeholders: {episode} = e.g. 5; {total} = e.g. 12. Length: short (≤ 16 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.episodeNoTotal: Same place as panel.nowPlaying.episode, when the total number of episodes is unknown (e.g. still airing). Placeholders: {episode} = number of the episode open in the tab, e.g. 1156. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.genres: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of the list of genre chips (screen readers only; genre names come from AniList in English). Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.loading: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of the loading skeleton (screen readers only). Meaning: the anime's AniList entry is loading. Length: medium. Notes: 'entry' = FR « fiche ».
panel.nowPlaying.malForum: Where: side panel › Now playing › Discussions, chip link. Meaning: opens the MyAnimeList forum (this episode's discussion, else the series forum). Length: short (≤ 16 chars). Notes: MAL = MyAnimeList, untranslated.
panel.nowPlaying.newTab: Where: side panel › Now playing, aria-label of external links (screen readers only). Meaning: the link opens in a new browser tab. Placeholders: {label} = link text, e.g. 'Episode discussion', 'MAL forum', 'Studio: MAPPA'. Length: medium.
panel.nowPlaying.noPage: Where: side panel › Now playing, centered status text. Meaning: the tab is on a supported streaming site but not on a series or episode page; opening one shows its AniList entry here. Length: medium, wraps (≤ 280 px). Notes: 'entry' = FR « fiche »; FR « tu ».
panel.nowPlaying.notFoundHint: Where: side panel › Now playing, hint under the 'no matching entry' message, after a decorative Japanese label 'ヒント'. Meaning: finish the episode; SyncKai will then ask the user to pick the entry in the popup's 'To check' section. Length: long, wraps. Notes: “To check” must match review.title.
panel.nowPlaying.progress: Where: side panel › Now playing, section heading (shown UPPERCASE) and its aria-label. Meaning: the user's status, episode progress and score for this anime in their lists, with actions. Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: FR « Ta progression » (tu).
panel.nowPlaying.readLess: Where: side panel › Now playing › Synopsis, text toggle button (expanded state). Meaning: collapse the long synopsis. Length: short (≤ 14 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.readMore: Where: side panel › Now playing › Synopsis, text toggle button. Meaning: expand the synopsis, cut after 5 lines. Length: short (≤ 14 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.reddit: Where: side panel › Now playing › Discussions, chip link (episode pages only). Meaning: opens a Reddit r/anime search for this episode's discussion thread. Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: noun phrase.
panel.nowPlaying.refresh: Where: side panel › Now playing, tooltip and aria-label of an icon-only button on the banner. Meaning: re-read the streaming page and reload the AniList entry. Length: short. Notes: 'entry' = AniList page of the anime (FR « fiche »).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.PARENT: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Parent': the main story that this anime is a side story or spin-off of. Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.PREQUEL: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Prequel': the entry that comes before this one in the story. Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.SEQUEL: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Sequel': the entry that continues this one (next season, film…). Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.SIDE_STORY: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Side story': a story set alongside this one. Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relation.SPIN_OFF: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small UPPERCASE label on a related entry, followed by ' · TV'. Meaning: AniList relation 'Spin-off': a separate work derived from this one. Length: short (≤ 18 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.relations: Where: side panel › Now playing, section heading (shown UPPERCASE). Meaning: AniList entries related to this anime: prequels, sequels, parent story, side stories, spin-offs. Length: short (≤ 26 chars).
panel.nowPlaying.score: Where: side panel › Now playing, tooltip and aria-label of the star rating (visible text is '86 %'). Meaning: average score given by AniList users to this anime. Placeholders: {score} = integer 0–100, e.g. 86. Length: medium. Notes: use the locale's percent format.
panel.nowPlaying.season.FALL: Where: side panel › Now playing, facts row. Meaning: autumn, as an anime airing season (AniList FALL), with its year (e.g. 'Fall 2024'). Placeholders: {year} = the airing year, e.g. 2024. Put the year where your language writes it ('2024年秋' in Japanese and Chinese, '2024년 가을' in Korean). Length: short. Notes: season name, not the verb.
panel.nowPlaying.season.SPRING: Where: side panel › Now playing, facts row. Meaning: spring, as an anime airing season (AniList SPRING), with its year (e.g. 'Spring 2025'). Placeholders: {year} = the airing year, e.g. 2024. Put the year where your language writes it ('2024年秋' in Japanese and Chinese, '2024년 가을' in Korean). Length: short. Notes: season name.
panel.nowPlaying.season.SUMMER: Where: side panel › Now playing, facts row. Meaning: summer, as an anime airing season (AniList SUMMER), with its year (e.g. 'Summer 2025'). Placeholders: {year} = the airing year, e.g. 2024. Put the year where your language writes it ('2024年秋' in Japanese and Chinese, '2024년 가을' in Korean). Length: short. Notes: season name.
