panel.nowPlaying.season.WINTER: Where: side panel › Now playing, facts row. Meaning: winter, as an anime airing season (AniList WINTER), with its year (e.g. 'Winter 2026'). Placeholders: {year} = the airing year, e.g. 2024. Put the year where your language writes it ('2024年秋' in Japanese and Chinese, '2024년 가을' in Korean). Length: short. Notes: season name.
panel.nowPlaying.studio: Where: side panel › Now playing, tooltip on the studio name, and label in its aria-label 'Studio: MAPPA'. Meaning: animation studio that produced the anime. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.synopsis: Where: side panel › Now playing, section heading (shown UPPERCASE) above the AniList description. Meaning: plot summary. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.soon: Where: side panel, placeholder card for a tab that isn't built yet (currently never shown: the Now playing tab exists). Meaning: the episode being watched will appear here. Length: medium, wraps.
panel.nowPlaying.watch: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', small button with a platform logo next to a related entry. Meaning: open that related anime on the streaming platform (new tab). Length: very short (≤ 10 chars). Notes: imperative verb.
panel.nowPlaying.watchOn: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', tooltip (title) of the Watch button. Meaning: watch the related anime on that platform. Placeholders: {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix or Disney+. Length: short.
panel.nowPlaying.watchAria: Where: side panel › Now playing › 'Sequels and related', aria-label of the Watch button (screen readers only). Placeholders: {title} = related anime title; {platform} = Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix or Disney+. Notes: '(new tab)' = opens in a new browser tab. Length: medium.
panel.enablePlatform: Where: side panel › Now playing (tab not on a streaming page), button under the notice. Meaning: enable SyncKai on this optional platform (the browser asks for site access). Placeholders: {platform} = Netflix or Disney+. Length: short (≤ 20 chars). Notes: imperative.
panel.offTargetEnable: Where: side panel › Now playing, sentence appended after panel.offTargetPlatforms (after a space; none in Japanese and Chinese). Meaning: these optional platforms can be enabled in Settings. Placeholders: {platforms} = 'Netflix, Disney+ and Prime Video', 'Disney+ and Prime Video' or 'Prime Video'; {path} = 'Settings › Playback & sync' (translated). Notes: 1 to 3 platforms: avoid agreement.
panel.offTargetPlatforms: Where: side panel › Now playing, notice when the active tab isn't a supported streaming page. Meaning: lists the sites SyncKai tracks. Placeholders: {platforms} = names joined with 'and' in the UI language, e.g. 'Crunchyroll, ADN and Netflix'. Length: medium. Notes: SyncKai untranslated.
panel.open: Where: popup header, tooltip and aria-label of an icon-only button. Meaning: open SyncKai's side panel (Chrome side panel / Firefox sidebar) next to the page. Length: short-medium. Notes: use the browser's usual term for the side panel.
panel.soon: Where: side panel, small badge on a placeholder card for a tab not built yet (currently never shown). Meaning: 'coming soon' (feature not available yet). Length: very short (≤ 12 chars).
panel.tab.agenda: Where: side panel tab label (calendar icon) and option of Settings › 'Tab on opening'. Meaning: weekly release schedule of the user's series (FR « Agenda », DE « Zeitplan »). Length: short (≤ 12 chars; 2 tabs share ~330 px, 3 options in Settings). Notes: noun.
panel.tab.nowPlaying: Where: side panel tab label (screen icon) and option of Settings › 'Tab on opening'. Meaning: the anime/episode open in the current browser tab, with its live sync progress. Length: short (≤ 12 chars). Notes: quoted in settings.panel.live.help; keep consistent.
panel.tabs: Where: side panel, aria-label of the tab list (Now playing / Schedule), screen readers only. Meaning: the sections of the side panel. Length: short.
popup.abandonFailed: Where: error alert in popup › Activity › Pending syncs. Meaning: 'Abandon' (removing a pending/failed episode sync from the retry queue) failed. Length: medium. Notes: 'sync' = one queued synchronization; informal 'Try again'.
popup.excludeFailed: Where: popup › Watching, red chip on the series row (truncated). Meaning: 'Stop syncing this series' failed. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: informal imperative.
popup.hostAccessAllow: Where: button in the amber banner at the top of the popup. Meaning: grant SyncKai access to the Crunchyroll / ADN websites (opens the browser permission prompt). Length: short (~14 chars).
popup.hostAccessDenied: Where: second line of the same banner, after the user refused the permission. Meaning: without access SyncKai can't detect episodes on these sites. Length: medium. Notes: 'track' = follow/sync viewing progress.
popup.hostAccessMissing: Where: bold title of the amber banner at the top of the popup (mainly Firefox). Meaning: the extension lacks permission to access the Crunchyroll and ADN websites. Length: medium. Notes: SyncKai, Crunchyroll, ADN are names; keep ' / '.
popup.ignoreFailed: Where: error alert in popup › Activity › To rate. Meaning: 'Ignore' (skip rating this series) failed. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
popup.includeFailed: Where: popup › Watching, red chip on the series row (truncated). Meaning: 'Resume syncing' for an excluded series failed. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars). Notes: informal imperative.
popup.logoutFailed: Where: alert in Settings › Accounts. Meaning: signing out of the AniList/MyAnimeList account ('Disconnect') failed. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
popup.queueReadFailed: Where: error alert in popup › Activity › Pending syncs. Meaning: the list of syncs waiting to be retried couldn't be read from storage. Length: medium.
popup.ratingsReadFailed: Where: error alert in popup › Activity › To rate. Meaning: the list of series waiting for a rating couldn't be read. Length: medium.
popup.sessionReadFailed: Where: alert on the popup welcome screen or in Settings › Accounts. Meaning: the stored AniList/MyAnimeList sign-in state couldn't be read. Length: medium.
popup.swTimeout: Where: error alert with Retry in popup › Watching. Meaning: the extension's background process didn't answer in time while loading the list. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
popup.swUnreachable: Where: error alerts and feedback almost everywhere (popup, side panel, Settings). Meaning: the page couldn't communicate with the extension's background process. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
popup.syncDisabled: Where: popup › Watching, info chip on the series row after 'Stop syncing this series' (detail in tooltip). Meaning: syncing is now off for this series. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars).
popup.syncDisabledDetail: Where: tooltip of the 'Sync turned off' chip; also message of a SyncKai toast on the streaming site. Meaning: the series can be synced again from the Settings section 'Excluded series'. Length: medium. Notes: path must match the translated nav.settings and settings.section.exclusions; keep '›'.
popup.syncEnabled: Where: popup › Watching, success chip on the series row after 'Resume syncing'. Meaning: syncing is active again for this series. Length: short (chip, ~25 chars).
popup.syncEnabledDetail: Where: tooltip of the 'Sync resumed' chip. Meaning: the next watched episodes of this series will be synced again. Length: medium.
prompt.rating.failed: Where: in-page toast bubble title on the streaming site, after rating with the stars. Meaning: the score could not be saved (per-service details below, with a Retry button). Length: short (bold title, 280 px bubble).
prompt.rating.later: Where: in-page rating bubble on the streaming site, secondary (ghost) button under the stars. Meaning: postpone the rating; the series goes to the popup's Activity › To rate. Length: short (≈ 12 chars).
prompt.rating.question: Where: in-page rating bubble on the streaming site, line under the title, above the 10-star rating. Meaning: asks the user's score for the series just completed. Length: short. Notes: informal 'your' (FR ta, DE deine).
prompt.rating.saved: Where: in-page success toast (pill) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: the score was saved. Placeholders: {score} = score out of 10, e.g. '8.5/10' (localized decimal). Length: short (≈ 25 chars, never truncated).
prompt.rating.saving: Where: in-page bubble title on the streaming site while the score is being sent; also screen-reader label of the spinner on popup Activity › To rate cards. Meaning: the rating is being saved. Length: short. Notes: keep the ellipsis.
prompt.rating.title: Where: in-page rating bubble title on the streaming site, shown when the last episode was synced. Meaning: the series is now completed (congratulation). Placeholders: {title} = anime title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: short + title (bold, 280 px bubble, wraps). Notes: use your language's quotation marks.
prompt.rewatch.failed: Where: in-page toast bubble title on the streaming site, after 'Yes, rewatching'. Meaning: the rewatch could not be recorded (per-service details below, with Retry). 'Rewatch' = watching a completed series again. Length: short.
prompt.rewatch.no: Where: in-page rewatch bubble on the streaming site, secondary (ghost) button. Meaning: answers 'No' to 'Rewatching …?'; SyncKai won't ask again for this series for 30 days. Length: short (≈ 10 chars).
prompt.rewatch.saved: Where: in-page success toast (pill) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: the series is now marked 'Rewatching' in the list, progress at episode {progress}. Placeholders: {progress} = episode number, e.g. 3. Length: short (≈ 25 chars). Notes: 'ep.' = episode abbreviation.
prompt.rewatch.saving: Where: in-page bubble title on the streaming site while the rewatch is being saved (message = series title). Meaning: in-progress state: 'starting the rewatch…'. Length: short. Notes: keep the ellipsis.
prompt.rewatch.title: Where: in-page bubble on the streaming site (question with No / 'Yes, rewatching' buttons). Meaning: an episode of a series already Completed in the list was watched: is the user watching it again? Placeholders: {title} = anime title. Length: short + title (wraps). Notes: informal you; your language's quotation marks.
prompt.rewatch.yes: Where: in-page rewatch bubble on the streaming site, primary (pink) button. Meaning: confirms watching the series again: sets its list status to 'Rewatching' (AniList REPEATING). Length: short (≈ 18 chars).
queue.abandon: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, small button on an item, next to 'Retry'. Meaning: verb: give up this sync, i.e. remove it from the queue without sending it. Length: short (≈ 12 chars).
queue.abandonAria: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the 'Abandon' button on a pending sync. Meaning: give up (discard) the sync of this episode. Placeholders: {title} = anime title + episode, e.g. 'Frieren · S1 E5'. Length: medium (not visible).
queue.failed: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, red status line of an item. Meaning: the sync failed and SyncKai stopped retrying automatically (gave up); the user can Retry or Abandon it. Length: short (≈ 25 chars, truncated).
queue.gone: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, result after 'Retry' (shown as 'Sync failed: …'). Meaning: this pending sync was already removed (synced or discarded meanwhile). Length: short. Notes: 'sync' = noun.
queue.nextAttempt: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, status line (clock icon) of an item waiting for an automatic retry. Placeholders: {when} = translated delay from queue.until.*, e.g. 'in 5 min', 'in 2 h', 'shortly'. Length: short (truncated). Notes: {when} already contains the preposition ('in').
queue.retryAria: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the 'Retry' button on a pending sync. Meaning: retry sending this episode now. Placeholders: {title} = anime title + episode, e.g. 'Frieren · S1 E5'. Length: medium (not visible).
queue.retryFailed: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, result after a manual 'Retry' (shown as 'Sync failed: …'). Meaning: the manual retry itself failed unexpectedly; try again later. Length: medium. Notes: informal you (FR tu, DE du).
queue.section: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the popup Activity section listing pending syncs. Meaning: syncs (noun) that failed temporarily and are waiting to be retried. Length: short (not visible).
queue.sectionTitle: Where: popup Activity tab, section heading (13 px). Meaning: syncs waiting for a retry. Placeholders: {count} = number of items, e.g. 2. Length: short (≈ 25 chars). Notes: the number in parentheses avoids plural agreement.
queue.sessionClosed: Where: popup Activity › Pending syncs, result after 'Retry' (shown as 'Sync failed: …'). Meaning: this pending sync belonged to an account signed out since; it was removed and nothing was written. Length: medium.
queue.until.days_one: Where: inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}' (popup Activity › Pending syncs). Meaning: next automatic retry in {count} day. Placeholders: {count} = 1. Length: short. Notes: plural pair (_one/_other); lowercase fragment that includes the preposition.
queue.until.days_other: Plural form of queue.until.days_one, inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}'. Placeholders: {count} = number of days (≥ 2). Length: short. Notes: lowercase fragment that includes the preposition ('in').
queue.until.hours: Where: inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}' (popup Activity › Pending syncs). Meaning: next automatic retry in about {count} hours. Placeholders: {count} = 1–24. Length: short. Notes: not pluralized: keep an abbreviation ('h'); lowercase fragment that includes the preposition.
queue.until.imminent: Where: inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}' (popup Activity › Pending syncs). Meaning: the next automatic retry is less than a minute away. Length: short (ideally one word). Notes: lowercase; must read naturally after 'Next try'.
queue.until.minutes: Where: inserted as {when} in 'Next try {when}' (popup Activity › Pending syncs). Meaning: next automatic retry in {count} minutes. Placeholders: {count} = 1–60. Length: short. Notes: not pluralized: keep an abbreviation ('min'); lowercase fragment that includes the preposition.
rating.groupLabel: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the 10-star rating control (in-page rating bubble, popup To rate cards, 'On this page' card, side panel). Meaning: give a score to this anime. Placeholders: {title} = anime title. Length: short (not visible). Notes: 'Rate' = verb.
rating.rateAria: Where: screen-reader label of each half-star button of the 10-star rating. Meaning: give this score. Placeholders: {value} = score from 0.5 to 10 with localized decimal, e.g. '8.5'; {max} = 10. Length: short (not visible). Notes: 'Rate' = verb.
ratings.completed: Where: popup Activity › To rate card, grey line under the series title. Meaning: when the series was completed. Placeholders: {relative} = translated relative time (time.*), e.g. '2 days ago', 'yesterday', 'just now'. Length: short (truncated). Notes: must read naturally with every time.* form.
ratings.ignoreAria: Where: screen-reader label of the 'Ignore' button on a popup Activity › To rate card. Meaning: dismiss this card without giving a score. Placeholders: {title} = anime title. Length: medium (not visible).
ratings.section: Where: screen-reader label (aria-label) of the popup Activity section 'To rate'. Meaning: completed series waiting for the user's score. Length: short (not visible).
ratings.sectionTitle: Where: popup Activity tab, section heading (13 px). Meaning: completed series waiting for a score (rating postponed). Placeholders: {count} = number of series, e.g. 2. Length: short (≈ 20 chars). Notes: 'rate' = give a score; number in parentheses.
recent.alreadyPendingAria: Where: screen-reader label of the disabled 'To check ↑' button on a recent sync (popup Activity). Meaning: a check card for this series already exists in the 'To check' section above. Placeholders: {title} = anime title + episode, e.g. 'Frieren · E5'. Length: short (not visible).
recent.correct: Where: popup Activity › Recent syncs, small button on each row. Meaning: VERB 'fix': reopen the match to pick another AniList entry/episode if this sync went wrong. Not the adjective 'correct' (= right). Length: short (≈ 12 chars).
recent.correctAria: Where: screen-reader label of the 'Correct' button on a recent sync row. Meaning: VERB: fix the sync of this series (choose another entry). Placeholders: {title} = anime title + episode, e.g. 'Frieren · E5'. Length: short (not visible).
recent.empty: Where: popup Activity › Recent syncs, empty-state text. Meaning: no episode has been synced yet. Length: short. Notes: 'syncs' = noun (synchronizations).
recent.line: Where: popup Activity › Recent syncs, grey second line of a row. Meaning: the AniList/MyAnimeList entry the episode was synced to, and the progress written. Placeholders: {title} = entry title, e.g. 'Frieren'; {progress} = episode number, e.g. 5. Length: short (truncated). Notes: keep '→' and ' · '; lowercase 'episode'.
recent.pending: Where: popup Activity › Recent syncs, disabled button replacing 'Correct'. Meaning: a check card for this series is already waiting in the 'To check' section above (the arrow points to it). Length: short (≈ 12 chars). Notes: keep '↑'; same wording as the 'To check' section.
recent.title: Where: popup Activity tab, section heading (13 px). Meaning: the last episodes SyncKai synced to AniList/MyAnimeList. Length: short. Notes: 'syncs' = noun.
review.candidatesAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the group of candidate AniList entries in a 'To check' card (popup › Activity). Meaning: pick the entry that matches the episode. Length: short.
review.deferredNote: Where: small grey note in a 'To check' card while a correction is pending. Meaning: a newly watched episode is waiting and will be applied once the user decides ('on hold' = set aside, not the list status). Placeholders: {number} = episode number, e.g. 6 ('?' if unknown). Length: medium.
review.dismissFailed: Where: error message in a 'To check' card, under 'Action failed'. Meaning: 'Ignore' (dismissing the to-check card) failed. Length: medium. Notes: 'review' = the to-check item (FR 'vérification'); informal imperative.
review.displayed: Where: header of a 'To check' card, e.g. 'S2 · E5 (shown as E30) · Crunchyroll'. Meaning: the platform displays this episode under another (absolute) number. Placeholders: {number} = displayed number, e.g. 30. Length: short. Notes: keep 'E' (episode): the 'S2 · E5' part is not translated.
review.empty: Where: popup › Activity › 'To check' section, empty state next to a check icon. Meaning: no uncertain match is waiting for the user. Length: medium.
review.episodeOnEntry: Where: label of the number field in a 'To check' card (followed by '/ 12'). Meaning: episode number to record on the selected AniList entry (may differ from the platform's number). Length: short-medium.
review.episodes: Where: details under each candidate entry in a 'To check' card, e.g. 'TV · 12 ep. · 2023'. Placeholders: {count} = episode count of the entry. Length: short. Notes: not plural-aware (no _one/_other): use an abbreviation valid for any number.
review.excludeTitle: Where: tooltip of the 'Stop syncing' button in a 'To check' card. Meaning: excludes the whole series (every season) from syncing; undo in Settings › Excluded series. Length: medium. Notes: path must match the translated nav.settings and settings.section.exclusions; keep '›'.
review.format.movie: Where: format label in candidate details of a 'To check' card. Meaning: AniList format MOVIE (feature film). Length: short.
review.format.special: Where: format label in candidate details of a 'To check' card. Meaning: AniList format SPECIAL (special episode). Length: short. Notes: TV, ONA, OVA stay untranslated nearby.
review.format.tvShort: Where: format label in candidate details of a 'To check' card. Meaning: AniList format TV_SHORT (TV series with short episodes). Length: short.
review.invalidEpisode: Where: bold error title in a 'To check' card when the typed episode number is invalid (message below). Length: short.
review.invalidMin: Where: error message under 'Invalid episode' in a 'To check' card. Meaning: the episode number must be 1 or more. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
review.invalidRange: Where: error message under 'Invalid episode' in a 'To check' card. Meaning: the number must be between 1 and the selected entry's episode count. Placeholders: {max} = that count, e.g. 12. Length: medium.
review.noCandidates: Where: 'To check' card, in place of the list of candidate entries. Meaning: SyncKai has no suggestion; search for the entry with the field below. Length: medium. Notes: informal imperative.
review.previousNote: Where: bold note in a 'To check' card after a sync was corrected to another entry. Meaning: SyncKai doesn't undo the earlier write; fix the wrong entry yourself. Placeholders: {title} = previously used AniList entry; {progress} = episode number written there. Length: long. Notes: informal tone.
review.results: Where: small heading above search results in a 'To check' card (shown in capitals via CSS; write normal case). Placeholders: {count} = number of results, e.g. 5. Length: short.
review.search: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the magnifier submit button next to the search field in a 'To check' card. Meaning: run the search (verb). Length: short.
review.searchAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the search field in a 'To check' card. Meaning: search AniList for another entry. Length: medium.
review.searchFailed: Where: bold error title in a 'To check' card (error message below). Meaning: the AniList search failed. Length: short.
review.searchPlaceholder: Where: placeholder of the search field in a 'To check' card. Meaning: search for a different AniList entry than the suggested ones. Length: short (narrow field). Notes: ends with '…'.
review.title: Where: popup › Activity, section heading. Meaning: uncertain matches the user must confirm (FR 'À vérifier'). Placeholders: {count} = number of cards, e.g. 2. Length: short. Notes: same wording as inline.toCheck.
settings.about.source: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › About card, external link row (opens the GitHub repository in a new tab). Meaning: the extension's source code. 'GitHub' untranslated. Length: medium, one line.
settings.account.connected: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, grey subtitle under the user's account name (or under the service name) in the account card. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Meaning: this account is connected to SyncKai. Notes: keep ' · '; the adjective may agree with 'account'. Length: short.
settings.account.loading: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, aria-label (screen reader only) of the placeholder shown while the account loads. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Meaning: the account's profile is loading. Length: short.
settings.account.logout: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, red text button at the right of each connected account row. Meaning: sign out of AniList/MyAnimeList in SyncKai (opposite of 'Connect'). Verb. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.account.logoutAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, aria-label (screen reader only) of the 'Disconnect' button. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Meaning: sign out of that service in SyncKai. Notes: same verb as settings.account.logout. Length: short.
settings.account.notConnected: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, grey subtitle under 'AniList' / 'MyAnimeList' when signed out (a 'Connect' button is at the right). Meaning: the account is not connected to SyncKai. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.account.openProfile: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, tooltip (title attribute) on the user's account name, a link opening their profile page in a new tab. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'. Notes: first person ('my profile'). Length: short.
settings.airing.checkNow: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes card, small text button right of the status line ('Last checked: 5 min ago · …'). Meaning: run the new-episode check now. Imperative. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.airing.checkTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes, tooltip (title) of the 'Check now' button while release alerts are on. Meaning: query AniList's airing schedule right away for newly aired episodes. 'AniList' untranslated. Length: medium.
settings.airing.checking: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes, status line text while the manual check runs (replaces 'Last checked: …'). Meaning: check in progress. Ends with an ellipsis (…). Length: short.
settings.airing.enableFirst: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes, tooltip (title) of the disabled 'Check now' button. Meaning: the release alerts toggle ('Notify me when an episode is out') must be on before checking. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.airing.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes, help text under the 'Notify me when an episode is out' toggle (also describes the Delay control). Meaning: alerts follow the time the episode airs in Japan; Crunchyroll and ADN often publish it a bit later. Length: long, wraps.
settings.airing.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes, toggle label. Meaning: show a browser notification when a new episode of a series the user is watching airs (release alert). 'out' = released. Length: medium, one line in a ~300 px row.
settings.airing.unavailable: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes status line, after 'failed: ' → 'Last checked: just now · failed: service unavailable, try again'. Meaning: the extension's background service didn't answer the check. Notes: lowercase fragment (DE nouns capitalized), no final period. Informal you (FR tu, DE du).
settings.autoSync.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): Settings home › Quick settings, and Playback & sync › Sync card; toggle label. Meaning: automatic synchronization of watched episodes to AniList/MyAnimeList (noun phrase, not an imperative). Length: short, ≤ 25 chars.
settings.backup.export: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card, outlined button; also the button of the Export section on the Backup page (full tab). Meaning: verb, export (download) a backup file of SyncKai's data. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.backup.exportFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card and the Backup page, red error alert. Meaning: the backup file couldn't be created or downloaded. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.backup.exportTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup, tooltip (title) of 'Export' in the side panel. Meaning: clicking downloads a .json backup file directly. Keep '.json'. Length: short.
settings.backup.exportTabTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup, tooltip (title) of 'Export' in the popup (a download would close it). Meaning: opens the 'Backup' page (that page's title) in a new browser tab, which downloads a .json file. Keep '.json'. Length: medium.
settings.backup.exported: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card, green status text with a check mark, shown for 2 s after a successful export (side panel; the popup exports via the Backup page). Meaning: past participle, 'the backup has been exported'. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.backup.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card, help text above the Export / Import… buttons. Meaning: what a backup contains: settings, matches (remembered season → AniList entry links), excluded series and sync history; never the AniList/MyAnimeList sign-ins. Length: long, wraps.
settings.backup.import: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup card, outlined button next to 'Export'. Meaning: verb, restore data from a backup file; it opens the Backup page in a new tab (hence the ellipsis …). Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.backup.importTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Backup, tooltip (title) of 'Import…'. Meaning: opens the 'Backup' page (that page's title) in a new browser tab, where the file is chosen. Length: medium.
settings.backup.crImport: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Import section, bold title of the card holding the Crunchyroll / ADN / Netflix buttons. Meaning: bring in the user's past viewing history from a streaming site to update AniList/MyAnimeList. Length: medium, ≤ 30 chars (wraps).
settings.backup.crImportTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Import card, tooltip (title) of each platform button. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Crunchyroll', 'ADN' or 'Netflix'. Meaning: reads the user's viewing history on that site and updates AniList / MyAnimeList, with a preview before anything is sent. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.delay.aria_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes, aria-label (screen reader only) of each Delay button. Placeholders: {count} = 0, 1, 3 or 6 (hours). Meaning: the release alert comes {count} hour(s) after the episode airs in Japan. Notes: the 'one' form may also be used for 0 (e.g. French).
settings.delay.aria_other: Plural form of settings.delay.aria_one (e.g. '3 hours after airing'); screen-reader label of a Delay button; {count} is 0, 1, 3 or 6.
settings.delay.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes, visible text of each button of the Delay control (0 h | 1 h | 3 h | 6 h). Placeholders: {hours} = 0, 1, 3 or 6. Meaning: hours after the Japanese airing. Length: very short, ≤ 6 chars: use your hour abbreviation (DE 'Std.').
settings.delay.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › New episodes, row label left of the 0 h / 1 h / 3 h / 6 h control. Meaning: how long after the Japanese airing the release alert is sent (noun). Length: short, ≤ 14 chars so the control fits on the same line.
settings.exclusions.empty: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Excluded series card, grey text when the list is empty. Meaning: no series has been excluded from syncing. Ends with a period. Length: short.
settings.exclusions.loadError: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Excluded series card, red error alert. Meaning: the stored list of series excluded from syncing couldn't be read. Length: medium.
settings.exclusions.loading: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Excluded series card, aria-label (screen reader only) of the loading placeholder. Meaning: the list of series excluded from syncing is loading. Length: short.
settings.exclusions.reactivate: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Excluded series list, small text button at the right of each series. Meaning: turn syncing back on for this series (remove it from the exclusions). Verb. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.exclusions.reactivateAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Excluded series, aria-label (screen reader only) of the 'Re-enable' button. Placeholders: {title} = series title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Meaning: resume syncing that series. Length: short.
settings.exclusions.reactivateFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Excluded series card, red error alert after 'Re-enable' failed. Meaning: syncing couldn't be turned back on for the series. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.help.clear: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Danger zone, red outlined button in the 'Error log' row. Meaning: verb, delete all entries of the error log stored in this browser. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.help.clearFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, red status line under the buttons, after 'Clear log' failed. Meaning: the error log couldn't be cleared. Length: short.
settings.help.cleared: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, green status line with a check mark, shown for 2.5 s after 'Clear log'. Meaning: the error log has been cleared. Length: short.
settings.help.copied: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, green status line with a check mark, shown for 2.5 s after copying. Meaning: the diagnostic report was copied to the clipboard. Length: short.
settings.help.copy: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, outlined button. Meaning: copy the diagnostic report (technical info for bug reports) to the clipboard. Quoted at the end of the GitHub issue template (help.issue.body): keep consistent. Length: medium, ≤ 28 chars.
settings.help.copyFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, red status line after 'Copy diagnostic report' failed. Meaning: the report couldn't be copied to the clipboard. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: short.
settings.help.copyTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, tooltip (title) of 'Copy diagnostic report'. Meaning: what the report contains: version, browser, settings and recent errors; never login tokens (OAuth access tokens) or account names. Length: medium.
settings.help.errors_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, grey status line under the buttons. Placeholders: {count} = number of errors recorded in the local error log. Meaning: errors stored in this browser. Keep {count} as digits: in some languages the 'one' form also covers 0 or 21, 31…
settings.help.errors_other: Plural form of settings.help.errors_one (e.g. '3 errors recorded'), grey status line in Settings › Help & about.
settings.help.noErrors: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, grey status line under the buttons when the error log is empty. Meaning: no error recorded in this browser. Length: short.
settings.help.report: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, outlined link-button with an external-link icon; opens a prefilled GitHub issue in a new tab. Meaning: report a bug/problem to the developers. Imperative or noun phrase. Length: short, ≤ 22 chars.
settings.help.reportTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, tooltip (title) of 'Report a problem'. Meaning: opens GitHub's new-issue form (bug report), prefilled. 'issue' = GitHub bug report (FR « signalement », DE « Meldung »). 'GitHub' untranslated. Length: medium.
settings.help.text: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about › Help card, help paragraph above the buttons. Meaning: the error log stays in this browser and is only shared if the user copies the diagnostic report. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: long, wraps.
settings.language.auto: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, first radio option, pinned above the language list. Meaning: follow the browser's language. Same word reused in the home summary 'Automatic (English)'. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.language.autoDetail: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, grey subtitle under 'Automatic'. Placeholders: {language} = name of the detected language in that language (endonym), e.g. 'Deutsch', 'Français'; English when the browser's language isn't supported. Length: short, single truncated line.
settings.language.groupLabel: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, section heading above the language list (CSS uppercases it: write normal case); also the accessible name of the radio group. Meaning: language of SyncKai's interface. Length: short.
settings.language.helpTranslate: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, external link row at the bottom of the list (hidden until a translation-site link is configured). Meaning: invitation to help translate the extension. 'SyncKai' untranslated. Imperative/infinitive. Length: medium.
settings.language.noResult: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, message replacing the list when the search matches no language. Length: short.
settings.language.searchPlaceholder: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Language, placeholder and aria-label of the search field above the language list (shown with 8+ languages). Meaning: type to filter languages. Length: short, ≤ 30 chars (field ~300 px).
settings.loadError: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), red error alert replacing the page content. Meaning: the stored settings couldn't be read; closing and reopening SyncKai (popup or side panel) reloads them. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, two short sentences.
settings.loading: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), aria-label (screen reader only) of the placeholder shown while settings load. Length: short.
settings.mappings.count_one: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches card, bold header (button) with 'Manage' at its right. Placeholders: {count} = number of remembered matches (platform season → AniList entry), ≥ 1. Notes: 'remembered' = stored by SyncKai. Keep {count} as digits: in some languages the 'one' form also covers 0 or 21, 31…
settings.mappings.count_other: Plural form of settings.mappings.count_one (e.g. '12 series remembered'), header of the Matches card.
settings.mappings.displayed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches list, grey fragment after '→ <AniList title> · '. Meaning: progress is computed from the episode number displayed by the platform (e.g. One Piece E1180), as opposed to settings.mappings.season. Notes: lowercase fragment; may be followed by ', offset of 24'.
settings.mappings.empty: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches card, grey text when nothing is remembered yet. Meaning: no match yet (match = remembered link between a platform season and an AniList entry; FR « correspondance », DE « Zuordnung »). Length: short.
settings.mappings.entryFallback: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches list, link text to the AniList page when the anime's title is unknown. Placeholders: {id} = AniList numeric ID, e.g. 21. Meaning: 'entry' = the anime's page on AniList (FR « fiche »). Keep '#'. Length: short.
settings.mappings.forget: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches list, red text button at the right of each remembered match. Meaning: delete this match so it is worked out again at the next episode. Verb. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.mappings.forgetAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches list, aria-label (screen reader only) of the 'Forget' button. Placeholders: {label} = the platform season, e.g. 'One Piece · S2 (East Blue)'. Meaning: forget the match for that season. Length: short.
settings.mappings.forgetTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches list, tooltip (title) of each 'Forget' button. Meaning: SyncKai will work out the AniList entry again the next time an episode of that season is watched. Length: medium.
settings.mappings.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches card, help text above the expanded list. Meaning: forgetting a match (remembered season → AniList entry link) makes SyncKai work it out again at the next episode; useful when it is wrong. Length: long, wraps.
settings.mappings.hide: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches card, toggle text (with chevron) at the right of the header while the list is expanded; collapses it. Opposite of 'Manage'. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.mappings.loadError: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches card, red error alert. Meaning: the remembered matches (season → AniList entry links) couldn't be read. Length: medium.
settings.mappings.manage: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches card, toggle text (with chevron) at the right of the header; expands the list of remembered matches. Opposite of 'Hide'. Verb. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.mappings.offset: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches list, grey fragment after '→ <AniList title> · '. Placeholders: {source} = settings.mappings.displayed or .season (lowercase); {offset} = integer subtracted from it to get the AniList episode, e.g. 24 (can be negative). Example: 'displayed number, offset of 24'. Lowercase fragment.
settings.mappings.reset: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Danger zone, red outlined button in the 'Matches' row. Meaning: forget all remembered matches (asks for confirmation first). Verb. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.mappings.resetConfirm: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Danger zone, yellow inline question shown left of the Cancel / Confirm buttons after 'Reset all'. Meaning: confirm forgetting every remembered match. Ends with a question mark. Length: short, ≤ 28 chars.
settings.mappings.saveFailed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches card, red error alert after 'Forget' or 'Reset all' failed. Meaning: the change to the matches couldn't be saved. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.mappings.season: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data › Matches list, grey fragment after '→ <AniList title> · '. Meaning: the match uses the episode's number WITHIN its season (e.g. episode 25 of the season), not the season's own number; contrast with settings.mappings.displayed. Notes: lowercase fragment; may be followed by ', offset of N'.
settings.notif.alertsAlways: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › On-page notifications, help under the three level cards. Meaning: warnings that need the user (match to check, error, reconnect) always show on the page, whatever level is chosen. 'Alerts' = these warnings, not release alerts. Length: medium.
settings.notif.alertsOnly.desc: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule, description of the 'Alerts only' radio card. Meaning: on-page messages only when the user must act: a match to check (uncertain match, FR « à vérifier »), an error, or a sign-in to renew. Short list of nouns after the colon. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.notif.alertsOnly.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › On-page notifications, title of the 3rd radio card; also starts the home summary ('Alerts only · alerts on time'). Meaning: on the streaming page, show only warnings needing action (not release alerts; DE « Nur Warnungen »). Length: short, ≤ 18 chars.
settings.notif.detailed.desc: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule, description of the 'Detailed' radio card. Meaning: after each sync, a full message bubble on the streaming page with the AniList and MyAnimeList results. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.notif.detailed.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › On-page notifications, title of the 2nd radio card; also starts the home summary ('Detailed · alerts +3 h'). Meaning: verbose notifications. Notes: adjective qualifying 'notifications' (FR « Détaillées »). Length: short, ≤ 16 chars.
settings.notif.discreet.desc: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule, description of the 'Discreet' radio card. Meaning: after a sync, a small pill in a corner of the video page for 3 seconds ('3 s'); nothing in fullscreen, only a check mark on the extension's toolbar icon. Length: long, wraps.
settings.notif.discreet.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › On-page notifications, title of the 1st radio card (with a 'Recommended' badge); also starts the home summary ('Discreet · alerts on time'). Meaning: unobtrusive notifications. Notes: adjective qualifying 'notifications' (FR « Discrètes »). Length: short, ≤ 16 chars.
settings.offsets.aria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › Schedule, aria-label (screen reader only) of each minutes field. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Crunchyroll', 'ADN', 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Meaning: how many minutes after the Japanese TV broadcast episodes appear on that platform. Length: medium.
settings.offsets.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › Schedule card, help under the minutes fields. Meaning: minutes after the Japanese broadcast, used by the side panel's Schedule tab ('Schedule' = that tab, panel.tab.agenda: use the same word); one series can be adjusted from its row there ('Adjust time'). Length: long, wraps.
settings.offsets.title: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › Schedule card, label of the group of per-platform minute fields (Crunchyroll, ADN, Netflix, Disney+). Meaning: estimated time an episode becomes available on each streaming platform. Length: medium, one line.
settings.offsets.unit: Where: unit after each minutes field (Settings › Notifications & schedule › Schedule, popup & side panel) and in the side panel's Schedule 'Adjust time' form. Meaning: abbreviation of minutes. Length: very short, ≤ 5 chars (DE 'Min.').
settings.percent: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): value next to the percentage slider in Playback & sync, its screen-reader value, and the home summary ('at 85%'). Placeholders: {value} = integer 70–98, e.g. 85. Notes: follow your locale's percent convention (EN '85%', FR/DE '85 %'). Length: very short.
settings.percentage.fallbackHelp: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Sync card, help under the slider when 'At the start of the credits' is chosen. Meaning: the percentage is used on platforms that don't report when the end credits start (ADN). No final period. Length: medium.
settings.percentage.fallbackLabel: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Sync card, label of the 70–98 % slider when the credits option is chosen (value shown at right). Meaning: backup percentage watched after which an episode counts as watched, used when credits are unknown. Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.percentage.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Sync card, help under the slider when 'At a fixed percentage' is chosen. Meaning: a new percentage takes effect from the next episode watched. No final period. Length: short.
settings.percentage.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Sync card, label of the 70–98 % slider when 'At a fixed percentage' is chosen (value shown at right). Meaning: share of the episode watched after which it counts as watched. Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.player.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Playback card, help under 'Preferred player'. Meaning: decides which streaming site the 'Open' button (common.open, quote its translation) uses when the anime is on several platforms. No final period. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.player.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Playback card, row label left of a segmented control (Crunchyroll | ADN | Netflix). Meaning: preferred streaming platform to watch on ('player' = streaming service, not a media player app). Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.entry.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, help under 'Default entry page' (row shown only when both AniList and MyAnimeList are connected). Meaning: which site's page opens when clicking an anime's title or cover art in SyncKai. No final period. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.entry.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Accounts, row label left of a segmented control (AniList | MAL). Meaning: which site's page of an anime opens by default ('entry' = the anime's page on AniList or MyAnimeList, FR « fiche »). Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.netflix.section: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync, section heading above the Netflix toggle (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: Netflix support only covers anime. 'Netflix' untranslated. Length: short.
settings.netflix.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Netflix card, toggle label. Meaning: turn on episode tracking and syncing while watching on Netflix (turning it on asks the browser for access to netflix.com). Infinitive/verb phrase. Length: short, ≤ 26 chars.
settings.netflix.helpOff: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Netflix card, help under the toggle while it is off. Meaning: only anime whose AniList entry links to Netflix are synced; turning it on shows a browser permission prompt for netflix.com. Keep 'netflix.com'. No final period. Length: long, wraps.
settings.netflix.helpOn: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Netflix card, help under the toggle while it is on. Meaning: only anime whose AniList entry links to Netflix are synced, also in Netflix tabs opened before it was turned on. No final period. Length: long, wraps.
settings.netflix.denied: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Netflix card, red message under the toggle. Meaning: the user refused the browser's permission prompt for netflix.com, so Netflix syncing stays off. Keep 'netflix.com'. Length: medium.
settings.netflix.disabled: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Netflix card, grey status under the toggle after turning it off. Meaning: Netflix syncing is off, but already open Netflix tabs keep tracking until reloaded. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, wraps.
settings.netflix.error: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Netflix card, red message under the toggle. Meaning: granting or removing the Netflix access permission failed. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.disney.section: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync, section heading above the Disney+ toggle (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: Disney+ support only covers anime. 'Disney+' untranslated. Length: short.
settings.disney.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Disney+ card, toggle label. Meaning: turn on episode tracking and syncing while watching on Disney+ (turning it on asks the browser for access to disneyplus.com). Infinitive/verb phrase. Length: short, ≤ 26 chars.
settings.disney.helpOff: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Disney+ card, help under the toggle while it is off. Meaning: only Japanese anime whose AniList entry links to Disney+ are synced; turning it on shows a browser permission prompt for disneyplus.com. Keep the domain. No final period. Length: long.
settings.disney.helpOn: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Disney+ card, help under the toggle while it is on. Meaning: only Japanese anime whose AniList entry links to Disney+ are synced; in a Disney+ tab opened before turning it on, tracking starts at the next episode. No final period. Length: long.
settings.disney.denied: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Disney+ card, red message under the toggle. Meaning: the user refused the browser's permission prompt for disneyplus.com, so Disney+ syncing stays off. Keep 'disneyplus.com'. Length: medium.
settings.disney.disabled: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Disney+ card, grey status under the toggle after turning it off. Meaning: Disney+ syncing is off, but already open Disney+ tabs keep tracking until reloaded. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, wraps.
settings.disney.error: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Disney+ card, red message under the toggle. Meaning: granting or removing the Disney+ access permission failed. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.prime.section: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync, section heading above the Prime Video toggle (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: Prime Video support only covers anime. 'Prime Video' untranslated. Length: short.
settings.prime.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Prime Video card, toggle label. Meaning: turn on episode tracking and syncing while watching on Prime Video (turning it on asks the browser for access to primevideo.com). Infinitive/verb phrase. Length: short, ≤ 30 chars.
settings.prime.helpOff: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Prime Video card, help under the toggle while it is off. Meaning: only anime are synced: titles in Prime Video's own 'Anime' genre, or animated titles that have a Japanese audio track or whose title exactly matches an AniList entry; turning it on shows a browser permission prompt for primevideo.com. Keep the domain. No final period. Length: long.
settings.prime.helpOn: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Prime Video card, help under the toggle while it is on. Meaning: SyncKai only reads the data the Prime Video page already receives from the site (it sends no request of its own); in a Prime Video tab opened before turning it on, tracking starts at the next episode. No final period. Length: long.
settings.prime.denied: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Prime Video card, red message under the toggle. Meaning: the user refused the browser's permission prompt for primevideo.com, so Prime Video syncing stays off. Keep 'primevideo.com'. Length: medium.
settings.prime.disabled: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Prime Video card, grey status under the toggle after turning it off. Meaning: Prime Video syncing is off, but already open Prime Video tabs keep tracking until reloaded. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, wraps.
settings.prime.error: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Prime Video card, red message under the toggle. Meaning: granting or removing the Prime Video access permission failed. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium.
settings.ratingPrompt.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › On-page notifications, help under 'Offer to rate…'. Meaning: a bubble asking 'Your rating?' (prompt.rating.question) appears on the page when a series becomes Completed in the user's list (page.status.COMPLETED): reuse both translations. Length: medium.
settings.ratingPrompt.label: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule › On-page notifications, toggle label. Meaning: when the user finishes a series (list status Completed), offer to give it a score. Length: medium, one line.
settings.recommended: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule, small green pill badge next to the 'Discreet' option title. Meaning: this option is recommended. Length: short, ≤ 14 chars.
settings.section.about: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, section heading above the version and source-code rows (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: information about the extension. Length: short.
settings.section.accounts: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary 'AniList ✓ · MAL ✓') and of that sub-page (truncated in the top bar). Meaning: the user's AniList and MyAnimeList accounts. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.section.airing: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule, section heading for release alerts (toggle, Delay, Check now); CSS uppercases it, write normal case. Meaning: newly released episodes. Length: short.
settings.section.backup: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, section heading above the Export / Import… card (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: backup (noun) of SyncKai's data; same word as the 'Backup' page title. Length: short.
settings.section.exclusions: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, section heading of the list of series excluded from syncing (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Quoted elsewhere as 'Settings › Excluded series': keep identical. Length: short, ≤ 24 chars.
settings.section.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Help & about, section heading above the diagnostic-report and report-a-problem buttons (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Quoted in the GitHub issue template path 'Settings › Help › …'. Length: short.
settings.section.language: Where: Settings (popup & side panel): title of a Settings home category row (summary shows the chosen language) and of that sub-page. Meaning: interface language. Length: short, ≤ 20 chars.
settings.section.mappings: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › My data, section heading (CSS uppercases it) of remembered matches, and title of the Danger zone row with 'Reset all'. Meaning: remembered links between a platform season and an AniList entry (FR « Correspondances », DE « Zuordnungen »). Length: short.
settings.section.notifications: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Notifications & schedule, section heading (CSS uppercases it) naming the three level cards (Discreet / Detailed / Alerts only). Meaning: messages SyncKai shows inside the streaming site's page after a sync, not browser notifications. Length: short, ≤ 30 chars.
settings.section.playback: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync, section heading above 'Preferred player' (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: video playback / watching (noun). Length: short.
settings.section.sync: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync, section heading above 'Auto sync' and the 'Episode watched' options (CSS uppercases it: write normal case). Meaning: synchronization (noun) with AniList/MyAnimeList. Length: short.
settings.shortcut.azertyKey: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts rows and home summary, hint after a digit key: 'Alt+Shift+1 (& key on AZERTY)'. Currently shown only when the UI is French, so other languages never display it. Placeholders: {char} = character printed on that key on AZERTY keyboards, e.g. '&'. Length: short.
settings.shortcut.edit: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, link-style button at the right of a row whose key is set; opens the browser's keyboard-shortcuts page. Meaning: change the key (verb). Quoted in settings.shortcuts.help: keep identical. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.shortcut.editAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, aria-label (screen reader only) of the Change/Set button of the 'Mark the current episode as watched' row. Meaning: change this keyboard shortcut, which happens in the browser's own settings page. Length: medium.
settings.shortcut.manual: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts (Chrome/Brave build), grey instruction under a row when the browser's shortcuts page couldn't be opened automatically. 'it' = the shortcut. Keep 'chrome://extensions/shortcuts' exactly. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: medium, wraps.
settings.shortcut.manualFirefox: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts (Firefox build), grey instruction when Firefox's shortcuts page couldn't be opened. 'it' = the shortcut. Keep 'about:addons' and '›'; use Firefox's own localized name of the gear-menu item 'Manage Extension Shortcuts'. Length: medium, wraps.
settings.shortcut.panelEditAria: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, aria-label (screen reader only) of the Change/Set button of the side panel row. Meaning: change the shortcut that opens/closes the side panel, in the browser's own settings page. Length: medium.
settings.shortcut.set: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, link-style button at the right of a row with no key; opens the browser's keyboard-shortcuts page. Meaning: assign a key (verb). Quoted in settings.shortcuts.help: keep identical. Length: short, ≤ 12 chars.
settings.shortcut.shiftKey: Where: inside displayed key combos (Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts and home summary): replaces 'Shift' in 'Alt+Shift+K' → 'Alt+Maj+K'. Meaning: the Shift key's name as printed on keyboards in your language (FR 'Maj', DE 'Umschalt'); 'Alt' is never translated. Length: very short.
settings.shortcuts.episode: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, label of the 1st shortcut row (key shown below). Meaning: keyboard shortcut that marks the episode playing in the current tab as watched and syncs it right away. Mirrors the command name in the browser's shortcuts page: keep consistent. Length: medium.
settings.shortcuts.help: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, help paragraph under the card. Meaning: a key the user changed survives extension updates; if a key is missing or taken by the browser or another extension, assign one with the 'Change' / 'Set' buttons (quote settings.shortcut.edit / .set). Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: long.
settings.shortcuts.panel: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts (Chrome/Brave build), label of the 2nd shortcut row. Meaning: shortcut that toggles SyncKai's side panel. Mirrors the command name in the browser's shortcuts page: keep consistent. Length: medium.
settings.shortcuts.panelFirefox: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts (Firefox build), label of the 2nd shortcut row. Meaning: shortcut that shows or hides SyncKai's side panel (Firefox sidebar). Length: medium.
settings.shortcuts.pointer: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Sync card, link-style row with a chevron at the bottom; opens the Settings › Shortcuts page. Meaning: keyboard shortcuts (noun). Length: short, ≤ 30 chars.
settings.shortcuts.unset: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Shortcuts, grey text shown instead of the key when the command has no key assigned. Meaning: no key set. Length: short, ≤ 16 chars.
settings.status.failed: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), top bar: red badge with a warning icon at the top-right, stays visible when a setting couldn't be saved. Meaning: saving failed (noun or adjective, e.g. FR « Échec »). Length: very short, ≤ 10 chars (overlays the page title).
settings.status.failedTitle: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), tooltip (title) of the red 'Failed' badge in the top bar. Meaning: the setting change wasn't saved; closing and reopening SyncKai (popup or side panel) reloads the settings. Informal you (FR tu, DE du). Length: short.
settings.status.saved: Where: Settings (popup & side panel), top bar: green badge with a check mark at the top-right, shown for 1.5 s after each change. Meaning: the setting was saved (past participle). Length: very short, ≤ 12 chars (overlays the page title).
settings.trigger.credits: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Sync card, 1st radio option under 'Episode watched'. Meaning: an episode counts as watched (and is synced) when its end credits start; recommended option. Completes the legend. Length: medium, one line.
settings.trigger.legend: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Sync card, bold legend of a radio group: 'At the start of the credits' / 'At a fixed percentage'. Meaning: the moment an episode counts as watched (a heading those options complete). Length: short.
settings.trigger.percentage: Where: Settings (popup & side panel) › Playback & sync › Sync card, 2nd radio option under 'Episode watched'. Meaning: an episode counts as watched once a set share of it has played (set with the 70–98 % slider below). Completes the legend. Length: medium.
sync.alreadyCompleted: Where: per-service result in the in-page toast ('AniList · …') and popup details. Meaning: progress not changed because the series is already Completed in that list (SyncKai may then offer a rewatch). Length: short. Notes: reason fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no final period.
sync.beyondEntry_one: Where: per-service result in the in-page toast ('MyAnimeList · …') and popup details. Meaning: not written: that service's entry has fewer episodes (seasons split differently). Placeholders: {progress} = episode, e.g. 13; {count} = the entry's episode count, e.g. 12 (plural variants; the English _one says "only episode" and omits {count}). Length: medium. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased (not German).
sync.beyondEntry_other: Plural form of sync.beyondEntry_one (e.g. 'Episode 13 exceeds the entry's 12 episodes'). Same place: per-service result in the in-page toast and popup details. Placeholders: {progress} = episode; {count} = the entry's episode count. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased (not German).
sync.correctionOutdated: Where: per-service result after confirming a correction (popup Activity › To check). Meaning: correction not applied because the list progress changed since the corrected sync. Placeholders: {progress} = current progress, e.g. 7. Length: long. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no final period.
sync.correctionPending: Where: reason in the in-page toast ('{reason}. Click the SyncKai icon…') and side panel status. Meaning: a correction is pending for this season; the episode is held and applied once the user decides on its card in the popup's Activity tab. Length: long. Notes: no final period; 'Activity' = tab name.
sync.correctionReason: Where: popup Activity › To check, reason line of a check card opened with 'Correct'. Meaning: correction requested; the series is currently synced to the entry {title}. Placeholders: {title} = AniList entry title, e.g. 'Frieren'. Length: medium. Notes: your language's quotation marks; no final period.
sync.invalidEpisode: Where: error on a popup Activity › To check card after confirming a choice. Meaning: the chosen episode number does not fit the chosen entry. Placeholders: {progress} = episode, e.g. 30; {title} = entry title; {total} = its episode count, or '?' if unknown. Length: medium. Notes: your language's quotation marks.
sync.noEquivalent: Where: per-service result in in-page toasts and popup/side panel details ('MyAnimeList: …'). Meaning: this service has no entry matching the AniList entry (e.g. no MyAnimeList ID), so nothing was written there. Length: short. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no period.
sync.noServiceFollows: Where: error in the popup/side panel or in-page toasts (rating, rewatch, comment, status, +1/−1, remove). Meaning: none of the connected services (AniList/MyAnimeList) has an entry (the anime’s page on that service) for this series, so nothing can be written; e.g. only MyAnimeList is connected and the AniList entry has no MyAnimeList ID. Not about the user’s list (the series may simply not be in it: that is another message). Say “has an entry/page”, never “tracks” or “follows”. Length: medium.
sync.recentNotFound: Where: error in popup Activity › Recent syncs after clicking 'Correct'. Meaning: that recent sync no longer exists. Length: short. Notes: 'Sync' = noun.
sync.reviewGone: Where: error in popup Activity › To check after confirming a card. Meaning: the check card no longer exists (already handled). 'Review' = a verification/check card (FR « vérification »), NOT a written review or critique. Length: short.
sync.sessionClosed: Where: per-service result in in-page toasts and popup details ('AniList: …'). Meaning: the account was signed out (or replaced by another) since the action started, so nothing was written to it. Length: medium. Notes: fragment; first letter lowercased by code (not German); no final period.
sync.seriesFallback: Where: used as the series title in popup/side panel results when the real title is unknown, e.g. '{title}: on hold'. Meaning: generic noun 'series' (an anime series). Length: short (one word). Notes: capitalized, singular.
time.countdown.days: Where: badge 'Ep. {episode} in {delay}' (popup Watching tab, 'On this page' card, side panel). Meaning: time until the next episode airs, in days. Placeholders: {count} = days (≥ 1). Length: very short. Notes: abbreviated unit ('d'); not pluralized: same form for every count.
time.countdown.hours: Where: badge 'Ep. {episode} in {delay}' (popup Watching tab, 'On this page' card, side panel), and the signed delay {offset} of the Schedule tooltips (agenda.estimate.title, agenda.estimate.custom). Meaning: a duration in hours (time until the next episode airs, or delay after the Japanese broadcast). Placeholders: {count} = 1–23 in the badge; in a delay, a signed number ('+1', '-2', up to '+168'), followed when needed by time.countdown.minutes ('+1 h 30 min'). Length: very short. Notes: abbreviated unit ('h'); not pluralized: same form for every count; keep {count} next to the unit so that a sign reads correctly.
time.countdown.minutes: Where: badge 'Ep. {episode} in {delay}' (popup Watching tab, 'On this page' card, side panel), and the signed delay {offset} of the Schedule tooltips (agenda.estimate.title, agenda.estimate.custom). Meaning: a duration in minutes (time until the next episode airs, or delay after the Japanese broadcast). Placeholders: {count} = 1–59 in the badge; in a delay, a signed number ('+45', '-30'), or the minutes after the hours without a sign ('+1 h 30 min'). Length: very short. Notes: abbreviated unit ('min'); not pluralized: same form for every count; keep {count} next to the unit so that a sign reads correctly.
time.daysAgo_one: Where: relative time, alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …' (popup, settings). Meaning: N days ago (2 or more; 1 day uses time.yesterday). Placeholders: {count} = number of days. Length: short. Notes: plural form chosen by the number; lowercase start.
time.daysAgo_other: Plural form of time.daysAgo_one: relative time 'N days ago' (2 or more), alone or as {relative} inside other strings. Placeholders: {count} = number of days. Length: short. Notes: lowercase start; must read naturally after 'Completed' / 'Analyzed'.
time.hoursAgo: Where: relative time, alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …' (popup, settings). Placeholders: {count} = 1–23. Length: short. Notes: not pluralized: keep the abbreviation ('h'); lowercase start.
time.justNow: Where: relative time (< 1 minute), alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …'. Meaning: a moment ago. Length: short. Notes: lowercase start; must read naturally after 'Completed' / 'Analyzed'.
time.minutesAgo: Where: relative time, alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …'. Placeholders: {count} = 1–59. Length: short. Notes: not pluralized: keep the abbreviation ('min'); lowercase start.
time.yesterday: Where: relative time (24–48 h ago), alone or as {relative} in 'Everything is synced · …', 'Last checked: …', 'Completed …', 'Analyzed …'. Length: short. Notes: lowercase start; must read naturally after 'Completed' / 'Analyzed'.
toast.line.saved: Where: in-page toast bubble on the streaming site, per-service line after a rating or rewatch ('AniList · saved'). Meaning: the rating/rewatch was saved on that service. Length: very short. Notes: lowercase fragment, no final period.
toast.pill.alreadyUpToDate: Where: in-page success toast (small pill, 3 s) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: the list was already up to date, nothing written (episode number unknown). Length: short (≈ 25 chars, never truncated).
toast.pill.saved: Where: in-page success toast (small pill, 3 s, 'Discreet' level) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: the watched episode was saved to the list. Placeholders: {episode} = episode number, e.g. 5. Length: short (≈ 25 chars, never truncated). Notes: 'Ep.' = episode abbreviation.
toast.pill.upToDate: Where: in-page success toast (small pill, 3 s) on the streaming site, followed by ' · {series title}'. Meaning: nothing written: the list already had this episode (or a later one). Placeholders: {episode} = progress already in the list, e.g. 5. Length: short (≈ 30 chars, never truncated).
watching.allWatched: Where: tooltip of the disabled '+1' button (popup › Watching rows and Continue card, 'On this page' card, side panel › Now playing). Meaning: every episode is already marked as watched. Length: medium.
watching.badge.available: Where: green chip on a series row (popup › Watching) and in the 'On this page' card / side panel. Meaning: the next episode to watch is already released. Placeholders: {episode} = that episode number, e.g. 3. Length: short (chip, ≤ ~22 chars). Notes: 'Ep.' abbreviation expected.
watching.badge.finished: Where: grey chip on a series row (popup › Watching) and in the 'On this page' card / side panel. Meaning: the anime finished airing (or was cancelled): no episode to wait for. NOT the user's 'Completed' status. Length: short (chip).
watching.badge.soon: Where: chip on a series row (popup › Watching) and in the 'On this page' card / side panel. Meaning: the anime is airing but the next episode's date isn't known. Length: short (chip, ≤ ~22 chars).
watching.badge.unknown: Where: grey chip on a series row (popup › Watching) and in the 'On this page' card / side panel. Meaning: no known date for the next episode. Length: short (chip).
watching.badge.upcoming: Where: chip on a series row (popup › Watching), 'On this page' card, side panel. Meaning: countdown to the next episode. Placeholders: {episode} = episode number, e.g. 5 (up to 4 digits: One Piece 1123); {delay} = translated compact countdown, e.g. '18 h', '2 d', '12 min'. Length: short (chip, ≤ ~22 chars); in a narrow Watching row the end of the chip is cut (full text in its tooltip), so put {episode} early. Notes: 'Ep.' abbreviation; reads 'Ep. 5 in 18 h'.
watching.confirm.COMPLETED: Where: inline confirmation (row '…' menu in popup › Watching; status row of 'On this page'/side panel), followed by Yes / No buttons. Meaning: confirm marking the series Completed. Length: short (~14 chars). Notes: question; keep '?' with locale spacing.
watching.confirm.DROPPED: Where: same inline confirmation, followed by Yes / No. Meaning: confirm setting the series to Dropped (abandoning it). Length: short (~14 chars). Notes: question; must not read as 'Cancel?'.
watching.confirm.no: Where: small button of the inline status confirmation. Meaning: No, keep the current status. Length: very short.
watching.confirm.noAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of that 'No' button. Meaning: cancel this status change. Placeholders: {action} = translated action label (watching.status.*), e.g. 'Drop' or 'Mark as completed'. Length: medium.
watching.confirm.yes: Where: small coloured button of the inline status confirmation. Meaning: Yes, apply the status. Length: very short.
watching.confirm.yesAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of that 'Yes' button. Meaning: confirm this status change. Placeholders: {action} = translated action label (watching.status.*), e.g. 'Drop' or 'Mark as completed'. Length: medium.
watching.empty.text: Where: popup › Watching empty state, text under 'Nothing in progress yet'. Meaning: watch an episode on a supported site; the series then appears here with its next episode's date. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'it' = the series; Crunchyroll, ADN are names; informal imperative.
watching.empty.textPlatforms: Where: same as watching.empty.text, when Netflix/Disney+ access is enabled. Placeholders: {platforms} = locale-formatted 'or' list, e.g. 'Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix'. Length: long (wraps). Notes: 'it' = the series; informal imperative.
watching.empty.title: Where: heading of the popup › Watching empty state. Meaning: no series in progress in your list yet. Length: short-medium.
watching.epShort: Where: right-aligned progress on a series row (popup › Watching) when the total is unknown (otherwise '5 / 12'). Placeholders: {progress} = episodes watched, e.g. 7. Length: very short. Notes: lowercase abbreviation expected.
watching.heroProgress: Where: Continue card line (popup › Watching), between −1/+1 in 'On this page'/side panel, per-list lines ('Watching · Ep. 5 / 12'). Placeholders: {progress} = episodes watched, e.g. 5; {total} = total episodes, e.g. 12. Length: short. Notes: 'Ep.' abbreviation expected.
watching.heroProgressNoTotal: Where: same as watching.heroProgress, when the total episode count is unknown. Placeholders: {progress} = episodes watched, e.g. 5. Length: short. Notes: 'Ep.' abbreviation expected.
watching.listAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the series list in popup › Watching. Placeholders: {service} = 'AniList' or 'MyAnimeList'; {sort} = translated fragment such as 'by next release' (watching.sortAria.*). Length: medium.
watching.loading: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the loading placeholder in popup › Watching. Meaning: your series list is loading. Length: short.
watching.menuAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of a series' '…' actions menu (popup › Watching rows; side panel › Now playing 'Your progress'). Placeholders: {title} = series title. Length: short.
watching.minusOne: Where: menu item in a row's '…' menu (popup › Watching); tooltip of the '−1' button ('On this page' card, side panel). Meaning: un-mark the last watched episode (progress −1). Length: short. Notes: keep '−1' with the minus sign.
watching.moreActions: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the '…' button on series rows (popup › Watching) and in side panel › Now playing. Meaning: open the actions menu. Placeholders: {title} = series title. Length: medium.
watching.mySeries: Where: section heading above the series list in popup › Watching. Meaning: the user's series in progress. Length: short (shares the line with the sort and AniList/MAL controls).
watching.nextWatched: Where: tooltip of the '+1' button (popup › Watching, 'On this page' card, side panel). Meaning: +1 marks the next episode as watched. Length: short-medium.
watching.noOther: Where: popup › Watching, under 'My series' when the only series is shown in the Continue card above. Meaning: no other series in progress. Length: medium.
watching.openOn: Where: pill link in the Continue card (popup › Watching). Meaning: open the series on the streaming platform. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Crunchyroll', 'ADN', 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Length: short (~20 chars incl. name).
watching.openOnAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of the platform links (Continue card pill and row screen icon, popup › Watching). Placeholders: {title} = series title; {platform} = streaming platform name, e.g. 'Crunchyroll'. Length: medium.
watching.searchOn: Where: menu item in a row's '…' menu (popup › Watching) and in side panel › Schedule menus. Meaning: search the series on a platform with no known direct link. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Crunchyroll', 'ADN', 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Length: short-medium.
watching.searchOnAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of that search menu item. Placeholders: {title} = series title; {platform} = platform name, e.g. 'ADN'. Length: medium.
watching.openPlatform: Where: pill buttons in the popup › Watching empty state. Meaning: open the platform's home page. Placeholders: {platform} = 'Crunchyroll', 'ADN', 'Netflix' or 'Disney+'. Length: short.
watching.plusOneAria: Where: aria-label (screen readers) of '+1' buttons (popup › Watching rows and Continue card, 'On this page' card, side panel). Placeholders: {title} = series title. Length: medium.
watching.resume: Where: label (and aria-label) of the card at the top of popup › Watching showing the series to continue watching. Meaning: 'Continue watching' heading, not a button. Length: short.
